confirmed.title: in_flight 計數只涵蓋 command()，同一條 link 上的 read/cancel/stop-all 會讓 cmd 認領別人的無 id 錯誤
confirmed.claim: `command()` 用 `self.in_flight.load(..) <= 1` 判斷「這則沒有 id 的裝置錯誤是不是我的結果」，但全檔只有 `command()`(605) 會 `InFlightGuard::enter`；`cancel()`(655)、`read_state()`(691)、`stop_all()`(743) 都不進入計數。而同一個 adapter 內所有 serial/mqtt/ble capability **共用同一個 DeviceLink**（lib.rs:1185-1214 明確要求並複用同一條 link），受器的輪詢 `read`（README 範例 pollIntervalMs 5000）與動器的 `cmd` 天然並行。韌體對沒有 id 的訊息（`read`、`stop-all`、壞行）一律回**沒有 id** 的 err（handleMessage:685-690 bad-json、755-758 not-paired），這些 err 會被同時在等的 `command()` 當成自己的回覆——正是 protocol.rs:615-620 註解自己警告的情境，但 guard 漏掉了三條路徑所以警告失效。
confirmed.evidence: protocol.rs:605 `let in_flight = InFlightGuard::enter(&self.in_flight);` 只出現在 command()；grep `InFlightGuard::enter` 全檔僅此一處。621-628 的 picker：`DeviceMsg::Err { id: None, reason } => { if self.in_flight.load(Ordering::SeqCst) <= 1 { Some(m.clone()) } … }`。read_state(691-738) / cancel(655-690) / stop_all(743-790) 本體內無任何 in_flight 操作。lib.rs:1186-1214 顯示同一 adapter 的 serial capability 共用 `serial_link`（`link.clone()`），mqtt/ble 同構(1262/1313)。link_caps.rs:260-281 把 `Ok(DeviceMsg::Err{reason})` 一律記成 `failed("device-refused", &reason)`。

verdicts.reasoning: Read the full protocol.rs (lines 300-800) and confirmed: (1) `InFlightGuard::enter` appears exactly once in the file (line 605), inside command() only — grep confirms no other reference. cancel() (line 655), read_state() (line 691) and stop_all() (line 743) never touch `self.in_flight`. (2) command()'s picker for an id-less DeviceMsg::Err (line 621) checks `self.in_flight.load(Ordering::SeqCst) <= 1`, which is exactly the count of concurrent command() calls, not concurrent requests on the link in general. (3) lib.rs:1186-1214/1226-1269/1284-1320 confirm all capabilities (serial/mqtt/ble) of one adapter share the same `Arc<DeviceLink>` instance via serial_link/mqtt_link/ble_link caching. (4) All of command()/cancel()/read_state()/stop_all() call `self.raw.subscribe()` on the same underlying `tokio::sync::broadcast` sender, so a single id-less DeviceMsg::Err broadcast is delivered to every concurrently-waiting caller. (5) ESP32 firmware (esp32-companion.ino:754-758) sends an id-less `not-paired` Err for a `read` message when unauthorized (Read has no `id` field in the wire protocol), and link_caps.rs:270-275 unconditionally converts any `Ok(DeviceMsg::Err{reason,..})` result from command() into a `failed("device-refused", reason)` receipt. (6) interaction-api/routes.rs:126/134 (GET observe) and executor.rs:650 (POST execute) are independent axum async handlers, so a receptor's read and an actuator's command on capabilities of the same adapter can genuinely run concurrently in production. I then wrote and ran an isolated integration test (crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/tests/protocol_race_repro_TEMP.rs, deleted after; `git status` confirms the crate directory is clean afterward) reproducing exactly the scenario in the finding: a command() and a concurrent read_state() in flight on the same DeviceLink, with the mock device emitting a single id-less `not-paired` Err (as the firmware would for the read). Result: `cmd_result = Ok(Err { id: None, reason: "not-paired" })` — command() wrongly claimed the read's error as its own outcome, i.e. it would be recorded as `failed("device-refused", "not-paired")` even though the error was meant for the concurrent read and the actual cmd's fate (ack or real refusal) is unknown/dropped. This is precisely the failure mode the file's own comment at protocol.rs 615-620 warns against ("把一個已經套用的命令記成 device-refused → 誘發重送 → 重複實體效果"), and the existing test `an_id_less_error_is_not_attributed_while_another_request_is_in_flight` only covers command()-vs-command() concurrency (which the guard does correctly handle, in_flight==2 there), leaving the cmd-vs-read/cancel/stop_all path completely uncovered. All cited line numbers match the current file content (no drift). Severity high is justified: it corrupts the ack/refused/timeout honesty distinction the whole adapter is built around, and a caller that (legitimately, per the codebase's own semantics) treats a definitive 'device-refused' as safe-to-retry — unlike an explicit outcomeUnknown, which the code deliberately never auto-retries — could end up re-issuing a command that was already applied, i.e. a real physical double-fire, exactly the invariant this project treats as inviolable.

親自逐行核對後,此 finding 成立,證據鏈完整且無反駁點:

1. `InFlightGuard::enter` 全檔（protocol.rs）唯一出現在 command()（605 行），grep 確認無第二處。in_flight 欄位的文件註解（317-322 行）明確寫的是「這條 link 上」的請求數，範圍是整條 link，但實作只計 command() 的請求數，範圍窄於宣稱。

2. cancel()（655-684）、read_state()（691-739）、stop_all()（743-793）三個方法內都沒有任何對 in_flight 的操作，各自獨立呼叫 self.raw.send_before(...) 後用自己的 broadcast::Receiver（self.raw.subscribe()）等待——與 command() 完全平行、無交互鎖。

3. ensure_ready()（424-470）只在「尚未握手」時才長時間持有 handshaken 鎖；一旦已握手（多數穩態情況），該鎖只是短暫檢查後立即放行，不會序列化後續 command()/read_state() 的 send+wait 週期。DeviceLink 內除 handshaken 外沒有其他 Mutex（grep 驗證），因此 command() 與 read_state() 可以在同一條 link 上真正同時各自送出訊息並等待。

4. lib.rs 1185-1218（serial，mqtt/ble 同構於 1226/1284 附近）證實同一 adapter 底下所有同傳輸的 capability（receptor 與 actuator）共用同一個 Arc<DeviceLink>。link_caps.rs 證實 LinkReceptor::read() 呼叫 link.read_state()、LinkActuator::execute() 呼叫 link.command()——兩者在 runtime 層是完全獨立的呼叫路徑（receptor 輪詢／runtime.rs observe_fresh 可隨時經 API 觸發，actuator execute 由 policy/executor 觸發），無 adapter 層級的互斥鎖序列化它們。

5. ESP32 韌體（esp32-companion.ino 741-760/681-690）證實：linkAuthorized 失敗時對 read／cmd／cancel 一律先擋在「一律要求已配對」分支，read 因為 host 端的 HostMsg::Read 序列化不帶 id 欄位，doc["id"] 取不到值 → sendErr(link, nullptr, "not-paired") 是無 id 錯誤；bad-json（690 行）也是無 id。這些與 claim 引用的行號一致。

6. 實測情境：command() 與 read_state() 各自在等待時，若韌體吐出一則無 id 的 Err（例如同一條 link 上 read 被拒，或訊息損壞觸發 bad-json），這則訊息透過 broadcast 同時送達兩邊等待者。read_state() 的 picker（718 行）對無 id Err 是「無條件」match（不看 in_flight），會正確地把它記成自己被拒；但 command() 的 picker（620-629 行）只看 self.in_flight.load() <= 1——因為 read_state() 從未讓計數器 +1，這個值仍是 1（只計了 command() 自己），於是 command() 也會把同一則、原本屬於 read 的錯誤誤判成自己的結果,把一個「還在等 ack、真實結果未知」的命令直接記成 failed("device-refused", …)（link_caps.rs 260-266 的轉換），而不是誠實的 Timeout/UNKNOWN。這正是 in_flight 機制存在的目的（見程式碼裡自己的中文註解 615-619 行），但因為只有 command() 參與計數，該保護在「receptor read 與 actuator command 平行」這個明確合法、架構上被允許（甚至是常態）的情境下形同虛設。

7. 現有測試 protocol_honesty.rs 的 an_id_less_error_is_not_attributed_while_another_request_is_in_flight（1259 行起）只涵蓋兩個並行 command() 呼叫（都會讓計數器 >1，因此該測試現有邏輯下会正確通過），完全沒有覆蓋 command()+read_state()／command()+cancel()／command()+stop_all() 混合並行的情境，所以這個缺口沒有被任何回歸測試釘住。

沒有找到任何序列化機制、測試防護或规格豁免可以推翻此 finding；claim 引用的所有行號（605/615-629/655/691/743，以及 lib.rs 1185-1214）都與目前檔案內容完全吻合，無漂移。這是真實的協定一致性缺陷，直接牴觸專案「誠實階梯」不變量（把「結果未知」錯誤地演成確定的 device-refused），嚴重度定為 high 合理。

confirmed.fix: 失效情境：受器 poll 送出的 `{"type":"read"}` 在序列線上掉一個 byte → 韌體回 `{"type":"err","reason":"bad-json"}`（無 id）；同一毫秒派出的 `cmd` 被韌體正常套用（LED 已亮／馬達已震）並在數 ms 後回 ack，但 host 的 command() 因 in_flight==1 先認領了那則 bad-json，收據記成 failed("device-refused","bad-json")——一個**已產生實體效果**的動作被記成失敗，誘導人／AI 重下同一命令＝重複實體效果。修法：read_state/cancel/stop_all 一律 `InFlightGuard::enter`，讓 `<= 1` 真的代表「這條 link 上只有我在等」；或更保守，無 id 的 err 一律只記進 unattributed、永不當成 cmd 的結果（逾時＝outcome UNKNOWN 才是誠實的預設）。

(unknown), not Ok(DeviceMsg::Err{..}) — i.e. extend the in_flight counter (or an equivalent per-link pending-request count) to cover cancel()/read_state()/stop_all() as well as command(). / 在 protocol_honesty.rs 新增一個 multi_thread 測試：ensure_ready 後，同時 spawn 一個 link.command(...)（ack_replies 關閉，讓它進入等待）與一個 link.read_state(...)（同樣讓它卡在等待，例如用一個永不回覆 State 的 mock），短暫 sleep 後 raw.emit_id_less_error("not-paired")，斷言 command() 的回傳必須是 LinkError::Timeout 且訊息含 "UNKNOWN"／"cannot be attributed"，而不是 Ok(DeviceMsg::Err{..})／不能被轉成 device-refused。

verdicts.reasoning:
逐一親自核對，三項程式碼修復與回歸測試皆真實存在且綠燈，文件敘述在目前磁碟狀態下確實是假的：

(2) credential_warnings：providers.rs:367 與 :384 的 `register_declarative_spec` 兩個分支皆呼叫 `merge_provider_detail(..., &built.warnings)` 把警告寫進 provider detail；回歸測試 `plaintext_credential_warnings_reach_the_provider_record`（providers_loop.rs:638）`cargo test -p interaction-runtime --test providers_loop plaintext_credential_warnings_reach_the_provider_record` → 1 passed，且驗證了狀態轉換後警告不被洗掉。
(3) BLE：mobile.rs:3240 `mobile_ble_scan(&self, duration_ms: u64, device_id: Option<&str>)`，內部用 `device_id` 建 `target` 傳給 `self.mobile.dispatch(target, ...)`；mobile_loop.rs:3170 有 `rt.mobile_ble_scan(600, Some(&id_b))` 的呼叫佐證簽章已支援指名裝置。

文件端逐字核對現行磁碟內容（未被漂移）：known-limitations.md:14-18（F-043 partial）、:36-38（credential_warnings 未轉發）、:42-44（BLE 無 deviceId）；CHANGELOG.md:91 與 :180；gap-matrix.md:288-289、:344、:347；release-readiness.md:21（關卡 13「2 項刻意 partial」）——皆確實仍描述「未修」，與現行程式碼矛盾。

唯一需要訂正的細節：(a) known-limitations.md 目前其實是**未追蹤（untracked）新檔**（`git show HEAD:docs/releases/v0.5.0-known-limitations.md` 找不到），CHANGELOG.md 的 Phase 9 段落與 gap-matrix.md 的對應段落也都在**目前未提交的工作樹改動**裡新增（`git diff` 顯示為 `+` 新增行，非既有 HEAD 內容），所以嚴格說「文件敘述在 HEAD 為假」不完全精確——這些內容根本還沒進 HEAD，是正在草擬中的發布文件。但這不影響 finding 的實質：commit 6ec0528（已是 HEAD c3d1786 的祖先）已修好三項並帶通過的回歸測試，而「現在磁碟上」（不論是否已 commit）的已知限制清單／CHANGELOG／gap-matrix／release-readiness 仍把它們寫成未修——這是審查當下可驗證的真實不一致，屬於 docs-claims 範疇的有效缺陷。(b) finding 引用 `release-readiness.md:69` 對應 #19 一段有誤——目前檔案僅 38 行，且第 19 列（版本一致性）內容與 F-043 無關；此為 finding 附帶引用的小瑕疵，不影響核心主張的成立（核心引用 release-readiness.md:21 完全正確）。

三項皆非「已被測試覆蓋的防護」誤判、非重複、非風格問題，而是文件與現行程式碼行為直接矛盾，且有可重現的通過測試佐證程式碼已修。故 confirmed=true。

嘗試反駁失敗；三項子主張全部經獨立驗證為真，且用可執行的回歸測試釘死。

(1) F-043：crates/interaction-runtime/src/executor.rs:729-743 在 ActionStatus::Acknowledged 分支從 `receipt.driver_response["deviceId"]` 取出 `tested_device`，呼叫 `note_capability_tested_on(..., tested_device.as_deref())`；providers.rs:519-540 的 `provider_of_capability` 在收到 `device_id` 時改用 `provider.mobile.<deviceId>` 精準查找，只有 `device_id=None` 才落回 `list().find(...)` 字典序。回歸測試 `tested_evidence_lands_on_the_phone_that_actually_ran_the_action`（mobile_loop.rs:3002）刻意挑「provider id 字典序在後」的手機當目標，並在註解直接寫明「舊實作用 list().find() 會記到另一台，這個測試就會紅」——本機執行 `cargo test -p interaction-runtime --test mobile_loop tested_evidence_lands_on_the_phone_that_actually_ran_the_action` 通過。已知限制文件所描述的「仍透過 list().find() 字典序第一個記證據」情境（兩台 iPhone 同時配對、動作指名 deviceId）在 HEAD 已被此改動直接堵死。

(2) credential_warnings：providers.rs:367 與 :384 的 `register_declarative_spec` 內確有 `merge_provider_detail(..., &built.warnings)` 呼叫，:97/:117 新增 `provider_detail_warnings()`／`warning_summary()`。回歸測試 `plaintext_credential_warnings_reach_the_provider_record`（providers_loop.rs:638）斷言警告值（含 secret:// 提示、且不回顯明文憑證）確實寫進 provider detail，本機執行通過。

(3) BLE：mobile.rs:3240 `mobile_ble_scan(&self, duration_ms: u64, device_id: Option<&str>)` 簽章即有 `device_id` 參數，函式內用 `dispatch(target, ...)` 指名送出；此參數其實在更早的 2e02284（Phase 6/7）就已存在，比文件宣稱的「沒有」更早失真。

git 佐證：三處程式碼改動皆由已提交的 commit 6ec0528（`fix(runtime): stop-all-sensors reaches the iPhone, runtime-owned emergency, honest agent estop, inbox counts`）引入，且 `git status --porcelain` 對 executor.rs/providers.rs/mobile.rs/两个测试文件均為乾淨（無未提交差異）——即這些修復是**已提交、非本輪待整合的 working-tree 草稿**，不是「另一個平行 agent 尚未合併的改動」可以拿來開脫。反觀 `docs/releases/` 整個目錄在 `git status` 下是 untracked（本輪 Phase 9 12 位 agent 新寫的草稿），CHANGELOG.md／docs/v05-capability-gap-matrix.md／docs/releases/v0.5.0-release-readiness.md 皆為 modified 但仍逐字保留同一句「仍透過 list().find()...」「未把 built.warnings 存進 provider record」「沒有 deviceId 參數」，與 HEAD 程式碼直接矛盾。我核對了 finding 引用的每一處行號：known-limitations.md:14（F-043 條目起始行）、CHANGELOG.md:91-92/180/185、gap-matrix:288-289/344/347、release-readiness.md:21（關卡 13）皆與現況逐字相符，唯一的小瑕疵是 finding 引用「release-readiness.md:69」但該檔僅 38 行（正確位置是 :27 的 #19 列）——這只是引用行號的筆誤，不影響其餘證據鏈的正確性，且該筆誤已在 evidence 中被 known-limitations.md §1 的實質引用覆蓋。

未找到任何反駁角度：不是風格偏好、不是已被其他機制覆蓋、也不是「finding 審查時檔案已被平行修復」（fix 是已提交的舊 commit，比這批草稿文件更早存在）。這正是 CLAUDE.md 明文要求「修掉時請同步更新這裡」被違反的具體案例，且直接餵入 release-readiness 關卡 13／CHANGELOG／gap-matrix §11，會誤導後續判斷「刻意保留 2 項 partial」而非「已全數修復、僅剩 ia-settings-012 一項」。維持原 severity=high：影響四份與發布判斷直接相關的文件、且與文件自身「沒有一項是猜測」的誠實聲明直接矛盾。

confirmed.title: CHANGELOG／migration／known-limitations 宣稱桌面端「尚未送出 stop-all reason」與「iOS 不會在 stop-all 設 emergency 角色狀態」，兩者在 HEAD 皆已實作
confirmed.claim: v0.5.0 對外契約與已知限制段宣稱桌面 mobile.rs 還沒送 stop-all 的 reason 欄位、使用者主動停感測時手機「仍會顯示因桌面緊急停止而停用」，並宣稱 iOS ActuatorCenter.stopAll 不會把 characterState 設成 emergency。兩項在 commit c3d1786 都已完成並有測試。
confirmed.evidence: 文件：CHANGELOG.md:176「桌面端尚未送出 `reason`（已知限制，見下）」、CHANGELOG.md:192-193「桌面端 `mobile.rs` 尚未送出 stop-all 的 `reason` 欄位…目前一律 fail-safe 顯示為『因桌面緊急停止而停用』」、docs/releases/v0.5.0-migration.md:74「桌面端尚未送出 `reason` 也尚未消費新的 `sensors` 回聲」、docs/releases/v0.5.0-known-limitations.md:49-52（#12）與 :53-57（#13）。實際程式：crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs:66-70 定義 STOP_REASON_USER／STOP_REASON_EMERGENCY，:472-477 `stop_all_wire_reason()` 把 audit reason「stop-all-sensors」映成 user、其餘映成 emergency，:1219 estop 路徑送 `{"type":"stop-all","sensors":…,"reason":STOP_REASON_EMERGENCY}`，:1270 `stop_sensors_for()` 送 `{"type":"stop-all","sensors":true,"reason":reason}`，:2255 以 `stop_all_wire_reason(reason)` 呼叫、:2505 每機端點傳 STOP_REASON_USER；單元測試 crates/interaction-runtime/tests/mobile_loop.rs:2920 `stop_all_wire_reason_only_calls_the_estop_path_emergency`。iOS 端 apps/interaction-ios/InteractionCompanion/Services/ActuatorCenter.swift:451 `func stopAll(sensors: Bool = false, reason: StopAllReason = .emergency)`，:471-481 依 reason 給不同文案並在註解寫明「stop-all{sensors:true,reason:emergency} 本身就是緊急停止的事實，所以這裡直接把角色狀態設成 emergency」。commit c3d1786 訊息亦明載「stop-all carries reason user|emergency … the App also switches the character to the emergency state」。（migration.md 同句的後半「尚未消費新的 sensors 回聲」經核對仍為真：mobile.rs:3105 只判 `v["stopAll"] == true`，未讀 sensors。）

verdicts.reasoning: Verified every citation against the current working-tree files (this checkout has uncommitted changes beyond commit c3d1786, and per instructions current file content is authoritative). crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs:67 and :70 define STOP_REASON_USER/STOP_REASON_EMERGENCY; :472-475 stop_all_wire_reason() maps audit reason 'stop-all-sensors'→user else→emergency; :1219 the estop path (stop_all_inner) sends {"type":"stop-all","sensors":sensors,"reason":STOP_REASON_EMERGENCY}; :1274 stop_sensors_for() sends {"type":"stop-all","sensors":true,"reason":reason}; :2255 mobile_stop_sensors() calls stop_sensors_and_wait(..., stop_all_wire_reason(reason)); :2505 the per-device /sensors/stop endpoint (mobile_sensors_stop) passes STOP_REASON_USER explicitly with a comment saying the phone must show "stopped by desktop" not "disabled by emergency stop". A unit test crates/interaction-runtime/tests/mobile_loop.rs:2920 stop_all_wire_reason_only_calls_the_estop_path_emergency asserts exactly this mapping, and an adjacent integration test stop_all_sensors_tells_the_phone_the_user_asked exercises the user-initiated path end to end. On the iOS side, apps/interaction-ios/InteractionCompanion/Services/ActuatorCenter.swift:451 declares func stopAll(sensors: Bool = false, reason: StopAllReason = .emergency), and its body (lines ~482-489) explicitly does `if reason == .emergency && characterState.state != .emergency { characterState.state = .emergency ... }` with a comment describing exactly this belt-and-braces rationale ("stop-all{sensors:true,reason:emergency} 本身就是緊急停止的事實，所以這裡直接把角色狀態設成 emergency"). Meanwhile the docs still assert the opposite: CHANGELOG.md:176 ("桌面端尚未送出 `reason`"), CHANGELOG.md:192-193 ("桌面端 `mobile.rs` 尚未送出 stop-all 的 `reason` 欄位...一律 fail-safe 顯示為「因桌面緊急停止而停用」"), docs/releases/v0.5.0-migration.md:74 ("桌面端尚未送出 `reason` 也尚未消費新的 `sensors` 回聲"), and docs/releases/v0.5.0-known-limitations.md items #12 and #13 (lines ~49-60) which separately claim mobile.rs hasn't added the reason field and that ActuatorCenter.swift's stopAll(sensors:) won't set characterState to .emergency. Both claims are directly contradicted by the current source. The finding's own caveat that the "sensors echo not consumed" half of migration.md:74 remains true also checks out: mobile.rs's websocket read loop only tests v["stopAll"] == true on ack (line ~3105), never reading a sensors field from the ack payload — so that residual sub-claim is correctly not part of what's being disputed, only the reason/emergency-state claims are stale. All line numbers cited in the finding matched the current file content closely (a few off by 1-4 lines), consistent with the finding author reading a slightly different in-flight revision of the same uncommitted working tree — this is unambiguously the same code the finding describes, not a coincidental match.

All cited evidence verifies exactly, on both sides. Code side (already committed at HEAD c3d1786, branch release/v0.5.0-product-hardening): mobile.rs defines STOP_REASON_USER/STOP_REASON_EMERGENCY (lines 67,70), stop_all_wire_reason() maps 'stop-all-sensors'->user else->emergency (472-475), stop_sensors_for() sends {"type":"stop-all","sensors":true,"reason":reason} (1270), mobile_stop_sensors() calls stop_sensors_and_wait with stop_all_wire_reason(reason) (2255), and mobile_sensors_stop() (per-device HTTP endpoint) sends STOP_REASON_USER explicitly (2505). Ran the cited unit test crates/interaction-runtime/tests/mobile_loop.rs::stop_all_wire_reason_only_calls_the_estop_path_emergency (line 2920) live: it passes and asserts stop_all_wire_reason("stop-all-sensors")==STOP_REASON_USER. On iOS, ActuatorCenter.swift stopAll(sensors:reason:) (line 451) branches display text on reason==.user vs default, and at 486-488 sets characterState.state = .emergency only when reason==.emergency -- exactly the belt-and-braces behavior the docs claim is missing; ConnectionManager.swift:385 and Protocol.swift decode the wire 'reason' field end-to-end into this call. The commit c3d1786's own message states this feature was added in that commit. Docs side: CHANGELOG.md:176 and :192-193, docs/releases/v0.5.0-migration.md:74, and docs/releases/v0.5.0-known-limitations.md items #12 (line 49) and #13 (lines 53-54) all still assert, verbatim at the cited lines, that desktop mobile.rs doesn't send reason and that iOS stopAll won't set characterState to emergency -- both demonstrably false against the code in the same commit tree. Notably git status shows CHANGELOG.md has 188 uncommitted insertion lines and docs/releases/ is an entirely untracked new directory, meaning this is live, in-progress release documentation that contradicts the code it ships alongside -- not resolved history and not a case of the finding being stale. This directly violates the project's own CLAUDE.md rule that known limitations must be synchronized when fixed ('已知限制記錄在 CHANGELOG.md 與 docs/acceptance-evidence.md，修掉時同步更新'), and is a genuine docs-claims defect affecting a safety-relevant UX distinction (user-initiated stop vs emergency stop), not a style preference or something covered by another mechanism. Every line number, function name, and test name in the original finding checks out exactly with no drift.

confirmed.fix: 改寫 CHANGELOG.md:176／:192-193、migration.md:74、known-limitations #12／#13 為已完成，並把仍為真的殘留（桌面未消費 ack 的 `sensors` 回聲）獨立列為一條，不要與已修好的 reason 綁在同一句。
confirmed.regressionTest: Add a pre-release doc check that fails if CHANGELOG.md / known-limitations.md still contain the string "尚未送出 stop-all 的 `reason`" while crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs already references STOP_REASON_EMERGENCY on the estop broadcast path — treat "known limitation" prose as a claim that must be re-verified against source before each release, not just at time of writing. / Add a doc-consistency check (or simply hand-edit) that fails CI/review when CHANGELOG.md / known-limitations.md assert 'reason 尚未送出' / 'stopAll 不會設 emergency' while mobile_loop.rs's stop_all_wire_reason_only_calls_the_estop_path_emergency test and ActuatorCenter.swift's reason==.emergency branch both exist -- i.e. treat the already-passing Rust/Swift tests as evidence the known-limitation entries are stale and must be deleted/updated before this branch is released.

confirmed.evidence: 文件：docs/releases/v0.5.0-test-matrix.md「整合階段最終一次全套跑」表 11 列全部 TBD-FINAL（Rust fmt/clippy/test、Tauri、typecheck、vitest、build、CLI E2E、Playwright、perf、ESP32），檔頭並自陳「不得把 TBD-FINAL 讀成通過或失敗」；docs/releases/v0.5.0-release-readiness.md 20 個關卡有 10 個是 pending final run；docs/releases/v0.5.0-final-report.md:152、:203、:227 亦是 TBD-FINAL。文件記載的數字（test-matrix 基準列、docs/acceptance-evidence.md:534-540）：Rust 595、Tauri 43、vitest 759/39 檔、Playwright 35/4 spec。本機在 HEAD c3d1786 實跑：`cargo test --workspace` = **685 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored**（62 個 test target，其中 46 個測試 binary）；`cargo test --manifest-path apps/interaction-desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` = **46 passed / 0 failed**；`pnpm test`（vitest）= **886 passed / 44 檔**。Playwright 未跑（依指示避開埠），但 apps/interaction-desktop/e2e/ 現有 12 個 spec、`test(` 共 65 個。另 docs/acceptance-evidence.md 最新章節停在「v0.5 Phase 8（2026-09-02）」（:510），全檔沒有任何 Phase 9 章節，違反 CLAUDE.md「交付前跑全套測試並回報實際數字」與「已知限制記錄在 CHANGELOG.md 與 docs/acceptance-evidence.md」。

verdicts.reasoning: All cited evidence verified exactly against current HEAD c3d1786: every line number (CHANGELOG.md:22, gap-matrix:254/336/340-341, test-matrix:38, final-report:152/203/227, acceptance-evidence:510/534-540) points to precisely the text quoted, with zero drift. The 'integration-stage final run' table in v0.5.0-test-matrix.md is indeed entirely TBD-FINAL. acceptance-evidence.md genuinely has no Phase 9 section (ends at Phase 8, line 510, file ends at 582). I independently re-ran the actual suites rather than trusting the finding's numbers: cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast = 685 passed/0 failed across 62 targets/46 binaries (exact match to the finding); Tauri backend = 46 passed/0 failed (exact match, vs documented 43); pnpm test = 886 passed/44 files (exact match, vs documented 759/39). None of these match any number recorded anywhere in the release docs, proving the docs are genuinely stale post-Phase-9-work while claiming (in gap-matrix:336) that Rust/vitest/Tauri/CLI E2E were '全部本輪實跑' in a way that reads as settled, when release-readiness.md's own table marks all of those as 'pending final run' alongside Playwright. This is a real, high-value documentation-consistency defect, not a style nitpick, not already fixed, and not something CodeGraph/grep contradicts. One trivial wrinkle: the finding's '10 個 pending final run' undercounts the actual table (11 rows), but that '10' is faithfully lifted from final-report.md §24's own (separately inconsistent) summary text, so it doesn't weaken the finding — it's additional evidence of drift, not a fabrication.

嘗試反駁未成立——所有引用逐一驗證，全部精確吻合：

1. `docs/releases/v0.5.0-test-matrix.md` 第40行起「整合階段最終一次全套跑」表格 11 列確實全數 `TBD-FINAL`（第44-55行），檔頭（第5-7行）確實自陳「不得把 TBD-FINAL 讀成通過或失敗」。file:line 給的 38 略微偏移（38 行實為 Stage-1 Playwright 局部子集列，TBD-FINAL 表格從 40 行標題開始），屬單純錨點漂移，不影響 finding 實質。

3. 本機在 HEAD c3d1786 親自實跑驗證：
   - `cargo test --workspace` = **685 passed / 0 failed**（62 個 test target、46 個含測試的 binary）——與 finding 陳述完全一致，且與檔案記載的任何數字（基準 595、Stage-1 各分項）都對不上。
   - `cargo test --manifest-path apps/interaction-desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` = **46 passed / 0 failed**——與 finding 陳述完全一致（檔案記載基準 43、Stage-1 43–45）。
   - `pnpm test`（vitest）= **886 passed（44 檔）**——與 finding 陳述完全一致（檔案記載基準 760/39 檔，Stage-1 最高見過 856/43 檔）。

4. `docs/releases/v0.5.0-final-report.md:152`「最終整合數字：**TBD-FINAL**」、:203「精確統計...**TBD-FINAL**」、:227「回填 TBD-FINAL」——三處引用行號與內容全部精確吻合。

5. `docs/releases/v0.5.0-release-readiness.md` §24（由 final-report:227 附近段落引用）確實是「met 8 項／pending final run 10 項／blocked-by-human 2 項」，20 關卡逐一核對屬實。

6. `docs/acceptance-evidence.md` 章節列表確認全檔在第 510 行進入「v0.5 Phase 8」後即結束（共 582 行），完全沒有任何「Phase 9」章節——而同一份 CHANGELOG.md 的 Phase 9 段落卻已把 43 項 fix 寫成完成式清單。這正是違反 CLAUDE.md 明文規則「已知限制記錄在 CHANGELOG.md 與 docs/acceptance-evidence.md，修掉時同步更新」的具體案例。

可能的反駁角度我都認真考慮過，但都撐不住：
- 「這只是誠實揭露的 WIP，不算違規」——但問題不在 TBD-FINAL 本身誠實，而在於 gap-matrix「全部本輪實跑」與 CHANGELOG 完成式敘述，跟它們自己指名的權威來源（test-matrix.md 整合表）矛盾，且 acceptance-evidence.md 完全沒同步，直接違反 CLAUDE.md 的具體條文，不是風格問題。
- 「或許『本輪實跑』指 Stage-1 分散跑」——就算這樣解讀，CHANGELOG／gap-matrix 都沒有把這個限定講清楚，讀者依指示追到 test-matrix.md 找「數字」時，權威整合表格仍是空的，且本機真實現狀（685/46/886）跟 Stage-1 記載的任何數字也對不上，證明文件確實已經跟目前 HEAD 脫節，並非我審查時已被修復——這些檔案目前狀態就是如此。
- 未發現任何跡象顯示此 finding 在我審查當下已被修復（並行修復），三個核心檔案內容與 finding 描述完全一致。

因此判定 confirmed=true，非「已被修復」誤判。

confirmed.title: 宣告式裝置 provider 的「停用／撤銷」不跨重啟：serial 埠與 MQTT broker 連線在啟動時無條件重開，裝置受器也回到啟用
confirmed.file: crates/interaction-runtime/src/providers.rs:275 (loop start); build/spawn at crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/lib.rs:1206,1254,1307; sensitivity default at crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/link_caps.rs:74; registry enable default at crates/interaction-registry/src/lib.rs:76
confirmed.claim: 人類把宣告式硬體 provider transition 成 Disabled 或 revoke 之後，只要 daemon 重啟，`init_providers` 就會無條件重新載入 `~/.adaptive-interaction/config/adapters/*.yaml` 並呼叫 `register_declarative_spec`，在 build 期就重新 spawn 實體連線（serial 開埠、MQTT 帶憑證連 broker 並 subscribe `.../from-device`、BLE），同時把該 spec 的受器重新註冊進 registry 並以預設值啟用。provider 記錄雖然停在 Disabled／Revoked，但沒有任何執行／讀取路徑檢查 provider 狀態，所以撤銷後的裝置在重啟後可以再被讀（外部連線也已經自己接回去）。這牴觸 CLAUDE.md「高風險能力在重啟後不得自動恢復」、spec §2「外部資料傳送需明確授權」，也牴觸這段程式自己寫下的規則。
confirmed.evidence: providers.rs:244-272 步驟 2 只把 `is_operational()` 的 provider 降成 Disabled（`desc.detail = "re-armed on restart requires explicit enable"`），沒有關連線、也沒有把該 provider 的受器／動器設回 disabled；Revoked 連降級都不觸發。providers.rs:275-307 步驟 3 走訪 `config/adapters` 每個 yaml 並 `register_declarative_spec(&spec)`，完全沒有讀 provider 狀態；providers.rs:358「A persisted record wins over a fresh one」分支只 `attach_capabilities` 後 return，同樣不看狀態。lib.rs:1206 `serial::SerialRawLink::spawn(...)`（serial.rs:120-155 立刻起 supervisor 執行緒開埠、退避重連）、lib.rs:1254 `mqtt::MqttRawLink::spawn(...)`（mqtt.rs:100-150 立刻連 broker，ConnAck 後 `subscribe(&topic_from)`）、lib.rs:1307 `ble::BleRawLink::new(...)` 都在 `build()` 裡。關連線的唯一入口是 providers.rs:729-732 `transition_provider` 與 771 `revoke_provider` 裡的 `close_declarative_links`，只有人類再按一次才會執行。受器啟用預設：link_caps.rs:74 `.sensitivity(Sensitivity::Internal, self.spec.requires_consent)`（spec 的 `requiresConsent` serde 預設 false，官方 ESP32 範例 firmware/esp32-companion/README.md:322-335 的 `env` 受器就沒有寫），配上 interaction-registry/src/lib.rs:76 `enabled: !manifest.requires_consent` → 重啟後啟用。provider 狀態在執行期完全沒被檢查：`is_operational()` 的 doc 寫「Only these states may execute/observe anything」（interaction-core/src/provider.rs:134-140），但全 repo 只有 providers.rs:261 一處呼叫它。crates/interaction-runtime/tests/providers_loop.rs 只測了 revoke 當下（213-247）與 operational→Disabled（296），沒有 revoke/disable 後重啟的回歸。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified every cited line and, more importantly, reproduced the behavior with a real (temporary, now-deleted) integration test against the actual runtime code — no mocking of the code under test.

Chain of evidence:
1. crates/interaction-runtime/src/providers.rs:244-272 (`init_providers` step 2): only downgrades a persisted provider that is `is_operational()` to `Disabled`; it never touches registry receptor/actuator `enabled` flags and never re-closes/blocks declarative links. A `Revoked` record isn't even touched by this branch (Revoked isn't operational).
2. providers.rs:275-307 (step 3): unconditionally walks `config/adapters/*.yaml` and calls `register_declarative_spec` for every spec, with **no read of the persisted provider's state at all**.
3. `register_declarative_spec` (providers.rs ~240s onward) calls `interaction_adapter_declarative::build(spec, ...)` **first**, before ever looking up the existing provider record. `build()` (interaction-adapter-declarative/src/lib.rs:1108+) unconditionally spawns `serial::SerialRawLink::spawn`, `mqtt::MqttRawLink::spawn` (which connects and subscribes), and `ble::BleRawLink::new` — real external connections with no gate.
4. `build()`'s receptors/actuators are then registered via `self.registry.register_receptor/register_actuator` — also before the "existing record" state check. Registry `register_receptor` (interaction-registry/src/lib.rs:76) sets `enabled: !manifest.requires_consent`; declarative receptor `requires_consent` defaults to `false` (lib.rs:116 `#[serde(default)] pub requires_consent: bool`) unless the YAML sets `requiresConsent: true` — confirmed the ESP32 reference `env` receptor example (firmware/esp32-companion/README.md:322-329) has no such field. So receptors come back `enabled=true` by default regardless of the provider's persisted state.
5. Only afterward does the code check `self.providers.get(&provider_id)` ("A persisted record wins over a fresh one") — and even then it only preserves the provider *record's* `state` field; it does nothing to re-disable the receptor/actuator entries it just registered or to close the links it just opened.
6. Confirmed `is_operational()` (interaction-core/src/provider.rs:135) has exactly one call site in the whole repo (providers.rs:261) — it is never consulted by `observe_fresh` (runtime.rs:558-559: `self.registry.receptor(receptor_id).await?` with zero provider-state check) or by `register_declarative_spec`.
7. Confirmed the disable path asymmetry: `revoke_provider` (providers.rs:755+) *does* correctly call `set_receptor_enabled(false)`/`set_actuator_enabled(false)` and `close_declarative_links` live — so at the moment of revocation the gate is real. But none of that state survives a restart, because step 3 rebuilds everything from scratch with fresh, enabled instances and fresh connections.
8. Checked crates/interaction-runtime/tests/providers_loop.rs: `operational_provider_does_not_auto_recover_after_restart` (line 296) registers a bare synthetic provider with no capabilities/links at all — it only proves the provider *record* stays Disabled, never touches the registry-level receptor path this finding is about. No test in the suite restarts a runtime that has an actual declarative receptor/link and checks its post-restart enabled state.

Direct reproduction: I wrote a temporary integration test (later deleted, `git status` confirms the tree is clean) that: starts a Runtime with an HTTP declarative device spec, confirms the receptor is `Available` (enabled) pre-revoke, calls `revoke_provider` (confirms receptor correctly becomes non-Available and provider record becomes `Revoked`), shuts down, and restarts `Runtime::start` on the same home dir. Result:
```
AFTER RESTART: receptor availability = Available (provider state = Revoked)
observe_fresh result after restart: true
```
The provider record correctly stayed `Revoked`, but the receptor came back `Available` in the capability registry and a live `observe_fresh` call (the same path the HTTP API/CLI use) actually succeeded in reading fresh data from the "device" — despite the human's revocation still being on record. This is the exact bug claimed, using HTTP as a safe stand-in for serial/mqtt/ble (whose `build()` call is even more severe: it unconditionally opens a real serial port / connects+subscribes to a real MQTT broker with credentials on every daemon start, regardless of persisted provider state).

This is a genuine, high-severity violation of the project's stated invariant ("emergency stop 與高風險能力在重啟後不得自動恢復") and of the very comment the code itself carries at providers.rs ~707-709 ("停用類的狀態…必須真的把裝置連線關掉：『停用』不能只是不派工，還在背景重連的連線＝使用者以為關了但沒關") — that guarantee holds only for the live transition, not across a restart.

Verified end-to-end by reading the actual code, not just the finding's excerpts.

1. `init_providers` step 2 (providers.rs:244-272) only downgrades `is_operational()` states (Available/Busy/Degraded) to Disabled; Revoked/Closed/Expired pass through untouched. Confirmed at providers.rs:261 `let downgraded = desc.state.is_operational();`.

2. Step 3 (providers.rs:275, comment "// 3) Declarative adapters" — line matches exactly, no drift) walks every yaml under `config/adapters` and calls `register_declarative_spec` unconditionally — it never reads the persisted provider descriptor's state before doing so.

3. `register_declarative_spec` calls `interaction_adapter_declarative::build(spec, …)` (providers.rs ~330), and `build()` (lib.rs:1108) unconditionally spawns the real transport: `serial::SerialRawLink::spawn` (lib.rs:1206), `mqtt::MqttRawLink::spawn` (lib.rs:1254, connects to the broker with resolved credentials and — per mqtt.rs's own doc comment — reconnects with backoff and re-does hello/pair on every generation), `ble::BleRawLink::new` (lib.rs:1307). This happens before any check of the previously-persisted provider state.

4. `register_declarative_spec` then calls `self.registry.register_receptor(receptor)` / `register_actuator(...)` for every capability BEFORE checking `self.providers.get(&provider_id)` (the "persisted record wins" branch is at providers.rs:357-358, after registration). `CapabilityRegistry::register_receptor` (interaction-registry/src/lib.rs:76) sets `enabled: !manifest.requires_consent`. For link-based receptors, `requires_consent` is taken verbatim from the YAML's `requiresConsent` field (link_caps.rs:74), which is `#[serde(default)]` → false when omitted (lib.rs:116). The shipped ESP32 reference YAML (firmware/esp32-companion/README.md, `env` capability, lines ~324-333) omits it, so that receptor registers as enabled by construction. (Link-based actuators are the exception: link_caps.rs:191 hardcodes `.requires_consent(true)` regardless of spec, so actuators do stay registry-disabled after restart — this narrows but does not eliminate the defect, since receptor/read access is what actually reopens.)

5. `is_operational()` (interaction-core/src/provider.rs:135, doc: "Only these states may execute/observe anything") is used exactly once in the whole workspace outside its own tests — the restart-downgrade step. Nowhere in the actual read path is provider state consulted: `observe_fresh` (runtime.rs:557) calls `self.registry.receptor(receptor_id)` directly, which only checks the CapabilityRegistry's own `enabled` bool (interaction-registry/src/lib.rs `receptor()`), never cross-referencing `ProviderState`. Same for the HTTP/tool paths (`receptor_read`, `receptor_test`, `interaction.observe` in interaction-api/src/routes.rs) and for `capabilities()`/`registry.snapshot` (runtime.rs:495) used for discovery — none of these look at the provider's Disabled/Revoked state.

6. `transition_provider` to Disabled (providers.rs ~726) closes the declarative links but does NOT disable the registry-level receptor/actuator enabled flags — disablement is enforced solely by keeping the connection closed, which is exactly what gets undone by the unconditional restart re-spawn in step 3. `revoke_provider` (providers.rs:755) does explicitly disable both receptors and actuators in the CapabilityRegistry (a correctness detail the finding didn't call out, but it doesn't rescue the bug) — however that disablement lives only in the in-memory `CapabilityRegistry`, which is rebuilt from scratch on every restart with no reference to the prior in-memory enabled/disabled decision; only the `ProviderDescriptor.state` field is persisted, and nothing consults it when re-registering capabilities.

7. Test coverage gap confirmed: `providers_loop.rs`'s `operational_provider_does_not_auto_recover_after_restart` (line 296) exercises a plain, capability-less provider (`provider.device.armed`, registered via `discovered(...)` with no attached receptors/actuators and no yaml under `config/adapters`) — it never goes through `register_declarative_spec`, so it only asserts the descriptor's `state` field survives as Disabled, never that a live capability is actually blocked. `pairing_ceremony_and_revocation_disable_capabilities` (line ~213) revokes a declarative provider but never restarts the runtime. No test creates a declarative link-backed provider, revokes/disables it, restarts, and checks the receptor is unreadable or the link stays closed — so the regression the finding describes is real and unguarded.

This is a genuine, current violation of the project's own stated invariant (CLAUDE.md: "emergency stop 與高風險能力在重啟後不得自動恢復"; spec line 466: "斷線後能力自動 unavailable；重連不得自動恢復高風險能力" — stated for the iPhone provider but reflecting the same system-wide principle CLAUDE.md states unconditionally) and contradicts the code's own doc comments in the same file (providers.rs step-2 comment: "Crash/restart must NOT auto-recover an operational device… a physical device never re-arms itself on its own"; module doc: "停用類的狀態…必須真的把裝置連線關掉：「停用」不能只是不派工，還在背景重連的連線＝使用者以為關了但沒關"). The practical blast radius is narrower than a full re-arm (actuators/commands stay gated because link-based actuators are hardcoded consent-required), but device receptor reads (sensor data) and the underlying physical/network connection (serial port, authenticated MQTT session) do come back after restart despite an explicit human Disable/Revoke, which is exactly the "silently undo an explicit safety decision" class of bug the invariant exists to prevent. Severity high (not blocker) is appropriate: it's a real, exploitable-by-a-restart safety regression on the sensing side, but not a catastrophic/irreversible physical-actuation failure since actuators remain properly gated.

confirmed.fix: init_providers 步驟 3 之後，依 persisted provider 狀態收斂：非 operational 的 provider 立刻 `close_declarative_links` 並把它的受器／動器 `set_*_enabled(false)`；或更好，在 `register_declarative_spec` 內先查 persisted 狀態，Disabled/Revoked/Expired/Closed 就只註冊 manifest 而不 build link（lazy 開連線）。另外把 `is_operational()` 真的接到 `observe_fresh`／`execute` 前的閘門上，讓 doc 的宣稱有牙齒。
confirmed.regressionTest: Start a runtime with a declarative device spec, revoke_provider the device (assert receptor Availability != Available and provider state == Revoked), shutdown, Runtime::start again on the same home dir, then assert the receptor's Availability is still != Available and observe_fresh(receptor_id) returns Err — currently it returns Ok with fresh data and Availability::Available. / In providers_loop.rs, write a device-spec-backed provider (a yaml under `config/adapters` producing at least one receptor, e.g. reuse `runtime_with_device_spec()`'s fixture), call `revoke_provider` (or `transition_provider(..., Disabled)`) on it, `rt.shutdown()`, restart a fresh `Runtime` on the same home dir, then assert that `rt.registry.receptor(&id)` errors (or that `rt.observe_fresh(&id)` fails) instead of succeeding — today it would succeed because `register_declarative_spec` re-registers the receptor as enabled regardless of the persisted Disabled/Revoked provider state.

confirmed.title: 緊急停止中連上／重連的 iPhone 不會被要求停止感測（只收到純 UI 的 character.present emergency）
confirmed.claim: emergency stop 生效後才完成 auth 的手機，永遠不會收到 `stop-all{sensors:true}`；桌面只 spawn `mobile_project_estop_device`，那只改手機上的角色文字標籤，不會停手機的麥克風／位置／BLE gateway。因此「緊急停止 → 手機端也必須停止感測」對這一條路徑不成立：手機在 estop 全程繼續擷取音訊，而桌面的 `status.activeSensors`／tray 是空的（受器已被停用，line 2313 會把它濾掉），使用者在桌面看不到任何仍在感測的跡象。
confirmed.evidence: mobile.rs:3043-3053 `auth` 成功後只做：`if self.is_estopped() { tokio::spawn(async move { rt.mobile_project_estop_device(&device_id, "reconnect-during-estop").await; }); }`——整個 handler 內沒有第二處送 `stop-all`（grep `stop-all` 只出現在 `stop_all_inner` 與 `stop_sensors_for`，兩者都只由 estop／stop-sensors 那一次掃描呼叫）。iOS 端 `ActuatorCenter.handleCharacterPresent`（ActuatorCenter.swift:429-436）只做 `characterState.state = state`，不碰感測；只有 `stopAll(sensors:true)`（ActuatorCenter.swift:451-490 → `stopSensorsOnStopAll`）才會關 mic／location／BLE gateway。既有測試 `phone_connecting_during_estop_receives_emergency`（tests/mobile_loop.rs:2444-2472）也只斷言收到 `character.present{state:emergency}`，沒有斷言 stop-all。

verdicts.reasoning:
逐段驗證屬實，且無安全網補償：

1. Runtime.emergency_stop()（runtime.rs:875-899）只在觸發當下對『那一刻已連線』的手機呼叫 mobile_estop_stop_sensors → mobile_stop_sensors → stop_sensors_and_wait，送出真正的 `stop-all{sensors:true}` 並等待 ack；這條路徑只執行一次。

3. `pair`（首次配對）分支甚至完全沒有 is_estopped() 檢查，情況更弱，但這超出本 finding 範圍，不影響對此 finding 本身的判斷。
4. iOS 端證實兩個 wire 訊息語意完全不同：ActuatorCenter.handleCharacterPresent（ActuatorCenter.swift:433-440）只做 `characterState.state = state`；只有收到獨立的 `stop-all` 訊息（Protocol.swift:490-492 解碼、ConnectionManager.swift:385-395 分派）才呼叫 ActuatorCenter.stopAll(sensors:true)（ActuatorCenter.swift:451-486），而只有這條路徑才觸發 `stopSensorsOnStopAll` closure（在 InteractionCompanionApp.swift:69 接到 SensorCenter/BLE 的真正停止）。character.present 不會、也不曾呼叫這條 closure。
5. 沒有補償機制：mobile.rs 內沒有任何 ping/watchdog/週期性重送 stop-all 給新連線手機；`mobile_register_provider`／`mobile_attach_conn`（2596-2667）也不含任何送出 stop-all 的邏輯。
6. 桌面端隱藏了這個落差：mobile_active_sensors()（2280-2312）以 `enabled`（registry 對高風險受器是否 disabled）為前提之一，而 estop 觸發時 mobile_disable_high_risk_receptors("*", ...) 已把該受器全域關閉，於是無論手機是否仍在物理擷取／串流，只要伺服器端的 observation 被丟棄（3059-3068 的 high_risk 丟棄邏輯，因為受器已停用而在到達前被擋掉、`mic_since` 從未被設成 Some），status.activeSensors 就會回空清單——與 finding 描述的『桌面看不到任何仍在感測的跡象』一致。
7. 既有測試 phone_connecting_during_estop_receives_emergency（tests/mobile_loop.rs:2444-2473）逐行核對：確實只斷言收到 `act`/`character.present`/`state:emergency`，全程沒有讀取或斷言任何 `stop-all` 訊息，因此現有測試套件不會攔到這個缺口。

confirmed.title: 玩具把互動框撐成聯集包圍盒，製造大片「既不穿透桌面、也不反應」的死區
confirmed.claim: `interactiveBounds()` 回傳「角色 hit-rect ∪ 所有非游標玩具」的**包圍盒**（不是聯集形狀），這個框整個被 Rust 端當成「游標在角色身上」而關掉點擊穿透；但 WebView 端 `pointerDown` 只認 `charHitRect()` 與玩具本體，框內其餘空白一律回 `"none"` 並直接 return。結果：只要把一顆毛球丟到遊玩場另一側，角色與玩具之間那一大條區域既不會把點擊傳給底下的桌面，點下去也完全沒有反應（不拖視窗、不開選單）。
confirmed.evidence: stage.ts:604-620 `interactiveBounds()`：`let x0=r.x; ... for (const t of solid) { x0=Math.min(x0,(t.x-14)*s); x1=Math.max(x1,(t.x+14)*s); ... } return {x:x0,y:y0,w:x1-x0,h:y1-y0}` —— 只排除了 `isCursorToy` 的光點／逗貓棒（companion-gameplay-004 的修法），一般玩具全部併進包圍盒。stage.ts:527 `reportHitRect()` 把它送給 host。src-tauri/src/lib.rs:2196-2208 `clickthrough_want_ignore()`：`let on_character = cx>=rx && cx<rx+rw && cy>=ry && cy<ry+rh; !on_character` —— 整個矩形都算「在角色身上」。CompanionApp.tsx:1650 `if (hit === "none") return; // 擴大互動框內的空白：不反應`。實算（scale=1、logical 320×170、ground=164、char.x=160）：`charHitRect` = x134..186；毛球落在 x=300 → bounds = x134..314，比原本的 52px 寬成長到 180px，x186..286 這 100×130 的區域變成死區。既有測試 regressions-run2-companion.test.ts:464 只釘了游標玩具那一種情形，沒有覆蓋這個。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified by direct code reading and an empirical repro test (written to a temp test file, run with vitest, then deleted — repo left clean).

1. `interactiveBounds()` (stage.ts:604-620) does compute a bounding box (not shape union) of `charHitRect()` plus every non-cursor toy, expanded ±14px each. `isCursorToy` (playfield.ts:200-201) only excludes `light`/`wand`; a `yarn` toy (the throwable "毛球") is not excluded, so dragging one far from the character stretches the box across the whole gap.

2. `pointerDown()` (stage.ts:625-634) only returns `"toy"` when a toy's own grab radius is hit, or `"char"` when inside `charHitRect()`; every other point — including points inside the expanded `interactiveBounds()` — returns `"none"`.

3. `CompanionApp.tsx:1650`: `if (hit === "none") return;` — this exits `onPointerDown` before setting `dragState.current`. Consequently `onPointerUp` (line 1723-1731) finds `dragState.current === null`, so neither the window-drag path nor the click-reaction/menu path (`d && !d.dragging` branch) fires. A click there produces zero visible effect.

4. `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` `clickthrough_want_ignore()` (fn starts at 2189, `on_character` check at ~2204-2205, minor line-number drift from the finding's cited 2196-2208 but same function/logic) treats the *entire* rect reported via `companion_hit_rect`/`reportHitRect()` (stage.ts:527, using `interactiveBounds()`) as "on character," so `want_ignore` is false there — the window keeps capturing clicks instead of passing them through to whatever is on the desktop underneath.

Empirical repro (StageRenderer, unfrozen via `machineStageFlags`, char at x=160 default so `charHitRect` = x∈[134,186]): spawned a `yarn` toy, dragged it to x=300, then `interactiveBounds()` returned `{x:134, w:180..193}` (i.e. x-range up to ~314-327). A point at (206,52) — inside that bounds box, outside `charHitRect`, and far from the toy's own grab radius — passed `pointerDown(206,52) === "none"`. Combined with the Rust-side click-through logic, this point is simultaneously (a) not click-through to the desktop and (b) not reactive in the companion UI: a genuine dead zone, exactly as claimed.

The only existing regression test for this area (`regressions-run2-companion.test.ts` companion-gameplay-004, ~line 464) only asserts that a *cursor* toy (light/wand) is excluded from the bounds, and only clicks exactly on a yarn toy's own center (`stage.pointerDown(yarn.x, yarn.y)`) — it never probes a point inside the bounding box but off any toy/character, so it does not cover this dead-zone case. Grepped `CHANGELOG.md`/`docs/acceptance-evidence.md` for any existing known-limitation entry covering this — none found, so it is not a documented/accepted gap either.

All three file:line anchors in the finding check out (stage.ts:604 exact; CompanionApp.tsx:1650 exact; lib.rs line numbers drifted slightly — 2189/2204-2205 vs cited 2196-2208 — but same function). This is a real, currently-reproducible UX dead-zone bug, not a safety-invariant violation, so "medium" severity looks appropriate as filed.

confirmed.fix: host 端改回報多個矩形（角色一個＋每個可抓玩具一個），或在 WebView 端把 `pointerDown` 的 `"none"` 改成「落在包圍盒空白 → 當成一般視窗互動（拖曳／開選單）」，並讓 Rust 端對每個矩形分別判定 on_character。最小修法：`interactiveBounds` 只在「玩具真的離角色很近」時併入，其餘玩具用獨立矩形回報。
confirmed.regressionTest: Extend the companion-gameplay-004 test: after dragging a `yarn` toy far from the character, assert `stage.pointerDown(x, y)` at a point that is inside `interactiveBounds()` but outside both `charHitRect()` and any toy's grab radius returns something other than `"none"` (e.g. falls back to allowing window-drag / click-through), not silently `"none"`.

confirmed.title: Reduced Motion 開啟時使魔狀態永久凍結：愛心永遠掛在頭上，Roll Call 說「在散步／在打招呼」
confirmed.claim: `stepFamiliars` 在 `inputs.reducedMotion` 時直接 early return，**在 `active` 閘門之後、狀態機推進之前**，所以使魔會停在切換當下的 `state`／`vx` 上永遠不再更新。若切換 Reduced Motion 時剛好有使魔處於 `greet`，`drawFamiliar` 會無限期畫出打招呼愛心；處於 `walk`／`chase` 的使魔則永遠帶著 `vx` 卻不移動，而 `rollCall` 只對 `frozen` 做了誠實降級、對 reducedMotion 沒有，於是誠實地寫著「在散步」「在追朋友」——實際上牠們一動也不動。
confirmed.evidence: playfield.ts:643 `if (inputs.reducedMotion || w.familiars.length === 0) { return char === w.char ? w : {...w, char}; }`（`f.stateUntil` 的重擲在 647 行之後，永遠到不了）。stage.ts:1138 `if (f.state === "greet" && !this.flags.frozen && statusOverlay(...) !== "takeover") this.drawGreetHeart(...)` —— 只擋 frozen，不擋 reducedMotion。playfield.ts:778 `const label = opts.frozen ? ... : f.state === "walk" ? "在散步" : ...` —— `rollCall` 的凍結殘影守則（776-777 行註解「不能拿它報『在散步』」）只套用在 frozen。實測（node 直跑 playfield.ts）：兩隻 idle 使魔以 rng=0.65 走一步 → 兩隻都進 `greet`（stateUntil=1002500）；接著以 `reducedMotion:true` 跑 2000 步／10 分鐘 → 仍然 `['a','greet'],['b','greet']`，rollCall = `[{小樞,在休息},{A,在跟大家打招呼},{B,在跟大家打招呼}]`。walk 案例同理：10 分鐘後 `['walk',-30,x=60]`，rollCall 仍說「在散步」。CompanionApp.tsx:817-830 的 `onMotionChange` 讓使用者在執行期切換系統 Reduce Motion 即可觸發。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自檢視並用 vitest 空跑複驗，claim 完全成立，且比原始描述更完整（連 walk 案例也一併釘死）。

1. 程式碼路徑核對（apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/playfield.ts）：`stepFamiliars` 中 `active` 閘門（627 行 `const active = inputs.ambient && ...`）之後、`reducedMotion` early return 在 643 行 `if (inputs.reducedMotion || w.familiars.length === 0) { return char === w.char ? w : { ...w, char }; }`——此行完全跳過後面 645 行起的狀態機迴圈（`if (now < f.stateUntil) {...} continue;` 與換狀態的 rng 抽樣），使魔的 `state`／`vx`／`stateUntil` 從此凍結在切換當下，不會再演進，甚至連 walk/chase 狀態下的位置推進（`f.x = clampN(f.x + f.vx*dt,...)`）都被跳過，因為連 `now < f.stateUntil` 分支都進不去。

2. 用 vitest 對 `playfield.ts` 原始碼直接複驗（臨時測試檔案，驗後已刪除，未留痕，`git status` 確認乾淨）：
   - Greet 案例：兩隻使魔 idle→（rng=0.65，非 reduced）進入 `greet`（stateUntil=1002500）；接著切 `reducedMotion:true` 跑 2000 步（相當於 32 秒 tick，遠超 greet 的 2.5 秒到期時間）後，兩隻仍是 `['a','greet',1002500]`／`['b','greet',1002500]`，`rollCall` 回報 `[{Char,在休息},{A,在跟大家打招呼},{B,在跟大家打招呼}]`——與 finding 描述的「兩隻都進 greet，reducedMotion 開啟後仍卡在 greet，rollCall 說在打招呼」完全吻合。
   - Walk 案例：一隻使魔以 `vx=25` 處於 `walk`，reducedMotion 開啟後跑 2000 步，`x` 座標分毫不動（`state:'walk', vx:25, x:60` 不變），`rollCall` 仍回報「在散步」。

3. `drawFamiliar`（apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/rig/stage.ts:1138）：`if (f.state === "greet" && !this.flags.frozen && statusOverlay(...) !== "takeover") this.drawGreetHeart(...)`——只擋 `frozen`，不擋 `reducedMotion`；而 `reduced` 變數（1077 行 `this.timeline.isReducedMotion() || this.flags.frozen`）只傳給 `drawGreetHeart` 控制 `swayAt`（211-216 行：`if (reduced) return 0;`），亦即 reducedMotion 時愛心不飄動但仍持續繪出——正是「永遠掛在頭上」（靜止不消失）的證據。

4. `rollCall`（playfield.ts:744-793）的凍結降級守則 `opts.frozen ? (...) : (...)` 只吃 `opts.frozen`（由呼叫端 stage.ts:572 `{ frozen: this.flags.frozen }` 傳入），完全沒有 reducedMotion 參數可傳——775-776 行的中文註解「不能拿它報『在散步』」明確只針對 frozen 情境設計，reducedMotion 情境沒有對應的誠實降級路徑，因而在「誠實階梯」不變量下構成違反：queued/frozen 之外還有一種「靜止但被報成在動」的未覆蓋狀態。

5. 觸發路徑核對（CompanionApp.tsx:810-830）：`motionQuery` 的 `change` 事件即時更新 `reducedMotionRef.current` 並透過 `gateway.reconfigure` 生效，1332-1393 行的 tick 迴圈把 `reducedMotionRef.current` 當作 `inputs.reducedMotion` 逐 tick 餵給 `stepWorld`，證實使用者在執行期切換系統 Reduce Motion 即可觸發，無需重啟。

行號、機制、實測結果三方印證一致，且此問題同時牴觸專案「感測不靜默」／「誠實階梯」不變量（reducedMotion 是一種真實狀態變化，但呈現層對它的『靜止』沒有誠實降級，反而讓 rollCall 撒謊式地報告動態活動）。嚴重度以 medium 為宜：非安全關鍵、非資料損毀，但會讓使用者長期看到與事實不符的角色狀態文字與視覺（愛心卡頭上、聲稱在散步卻不動），屬於明確可重現的呈現層 bug。

confirmed.fix: 把 reducedMotion 的處理從「early return」改成「先把所有使魔收斂到 idle／vx=0／greetWith=null（等同 `!active` 分支），再 return」；並讓 `rollCall` 接收 `reducedMotion` 旗標，比照 frozen 回報「停下來了」。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在 `src/test/playfield.test.ts` 的「使魔與 Roll Call」describe 下新增一個 case：以固定 rng 讓使魔進入 `greet`（或手動設定初始 `state:"walk", vx:25`），接著用 `reducedMotion:true` 跑上千步／模擬數分鐘，斷言 `familiar.state`／`x` 完全不變（凍結）且 `rollCall(...).activity` 對該使魔輸出的仍是「在跟大家打招呼」/「在散步」——先紅（證明現狀撒謊）；修法應是讓 `rollCall` 與 `drawFamiliar` 對 reducedMotion 比照 `frozen` 做同款「停下來了」式誠實降級，或讓 `stepFamiliars` 在 reducedMotion 時仍推進到下一個穩定/idle 狀態而非原地凍結在動態狀態上，然後測試轉綠。

confirmed.title: 玩具已達上限時丟光點／逗貓棒：什麼都沒生成，卻回報成功、送出 toy-thrown 事件並寫進互動記憶
confirmed.claim: `StageRenderer.spawnToy()` 用 `this.world.toys.length > before || isCursorToy(kind)` 判定成功。`isCursorToy` 那一項本來是為了「光點已存在→替換」（數量不變但確實生成）而加的，但它同時把「已達 MAX_TOYS＝4 且場上沒有同種游標玩具」這個**完全沒生成**的情形也判成成功。於是 UI 什麼都沒出現，卻仍然對 Runtime 送出 `character.toy-thrown` 輸入事件，並把「玩過光點」寫進 `companionInteractionMemory` 持久化——違反誠實階梯（沒發生的事不得當成發生）。
confirmed.evidence: stage.ts:552-558 `spawnToy(kind){ if(this.flags.frozen) return false; const before=this.world.toys.length; this.world=spawnToy(this.world,kind,this.now()); return this.world.toys.length > before || isCursorToy(kind); }`。playfield.ts:169-189 `spawnToy()`：先 `toys.filter(t=>t.kind!==kind)`（游標玩具），再 `if (world.toys.length >= MAX_TOYS) return world;`（MAX_TOYS=4，playfield.ts:137）。character/adapters/shu.ts:440-446 `spawnToy: (kind)=>{ ... if(!this.stage.spawnToy(kind)) return null; this.emitInput({kind:"character.toy-thrown",payload:{toyId:kind}}); return kind; }`（註解自稱「玩具已滿時拒絕：沒生成就不說生成了」）。CompanionApp.tsx:1851-1855 `if (gameplay.spawnToy(kind) === null) return; const mem = notePlay(memoryRef.current, kind, Date.now()); ... desktop.prefsPatch({companionInteractionMemory: mem})`。實測（node 直跑 playfield.ts）：丟 yarn/paper/plane/yarn 得 4 顆 → 再丟 light → `{before:4, after:4, lightPresent:false}`，而 stage 的回傳式在此為 `false || true = true`。
confirmed.fix: 讓 `playfield.spawnToy` 回傳是否真的生成（例如回 `{world, spawned:boolean}` 或比較 `world.toys` 是否含有該 id），`StageRenderer.spawnToy` 依此回報；不要用 `isCursorToy(kind)` 當成無條件成功。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在 stage.ts 的測試中：先用 stage.spawnToy() 依序丟滿 4 顆非游標玩具（如 yarn/paper/plane/yarn）使 world.toys.length===4，接著呼叫 stage.spawnToy("light")，斷言其回傳值為 false 且 stage.toyCount() 仍為 4（目前實際回傳 true，違反預期）；再於 shu.ts adapter 層斷言此情境下 gameplay.spawnToy("light") 回傳 null 且未 emitInput 一個 character.toy-thrown 事件。

confirmed.title: 主角與使魔的「互相注意」是單向的：小樞永遠只被打招呼，從不主動靠近、打招呼或追逐使魔
confirmed.claim: 規格 §5.1 要求「多角色能互相注意、打招呼、出現愛心、追逐及玩耍」。實作中使魔↔使魔確實是雙向的（greet 會讓對方也 greet；chase 會讓對方逃跑或回頭），但主角↔使魔只有單向：`char.attendTo`／`greetBackUntil` **只**在 `stepFamiliars` 裡由使魔發起 greet 時被設定，`stepChar` 從頭到尾不認識 `w.familiars`（除了拿來決定 `facing`），沒有任何路徑讓主角主動走向、打招呼、追逐或和使魔玩。主角的「互動」上限是原地轉頭＋35% 機率冒一顆愛心。
confirmed.evidence: playfield.ts:355-595 `stepChar()`：唯一引用 familiars 之處是 368-371 行 `const f = w.familiars.find(x=>x.id===c.attendTo); if (f) c.facing = f.x >= c.x ? 1 : -1;`；`CharPlayMode` 的所有分支（free/stroll/sniff/chase/pounce/return/refuse）目標都只有 `targetToy`，沒有 familiar 目標。playfield.ts:679-687：`char = {...char, attendTo: f.id, attendUntil: now+2500, greetBackUntil: rng()<0.35 ? now+1800 : char.greetBackUntil}` —— 主角狀態只在此處（使魔那一側）被寫入。playfield.ts:698-725 的 chase／flee／look-back 只在 `list`（使魔）之間發生。docs/acceptance-evidence.md:490 的已知限制第 8 項只涵蓋「跨螢幕漫遊／坐視窗邊緣／探頭／躲視窗後」，沒有涵蓋這一項。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自逐行核對 apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/playfield.ts，finding 的每一項技術描述都準確：

1. `stepChar()`（355-595 行）內對 `w.familiars` 的唯一引用就在 368-371 行——`canPlay && c.attendTo !== null && c.mode === "free" && now <= c.attendUntil` 時把 `facing` 轉向該使魔，僅此而已。`CharPlayMode` 的 switch（free/stroll/sniff/chase/pounce/return/refuse，374-593 行）逐一讀過，所有分支的目標只有 `c.targetToy`／`c.carryToy`（玩具），沒有任何分支以 `w.familiars` 中的 id 當作移動或行為目標。

2. `char.attendTo`／`greetBackUntil` 只在 `stepFamiliars()`（611-733 行）裡、且僅在「使魔 greet 到主角」那個分支（667-687 行，`target.id === "char"` 時）才被寫入：
   ```
   char = { ...char, attendTo: f.id, attendUntil: now + 2_500,
     greetBackUntil: rng() < 0.35 ? now + 1_800 : char.greetBackUntil };
   events.push({ type: "greeted-by", id: f.id });
   ```
   反向（主角主動對使魔打招呼/靠近/追逐）沒有任何寫入路徑——grep 全檔案 `familiars\b`／`attendTo` 找不到第二個賦值來源。

3. 使魔↔使魔確實雙向：greet 分支裡 `target.id !== "char"` 時對方也被設成 `state="greet"`（691-696 行）；chase 分支裡被追的一方會 flee 或 look-back（712-728 行）。這部分與 finding 描述一致。

4. 佐證 finding 對「規格未涵蓋」的查核：docs/acceptance-evidence.md 的「已知限制（v0.5）」第 8 項只講「跨螢幕漫遊／坐視窗邊緣／探頭／躲視窗後」，沒有涵蓋主角↔使魔單向注意這件事，finding 引用正確。

5. 規格 §5.1（docs/specs/...:190）「多角色能互相注意、打招呼、出現愛心、追逐及玩耍」確實存在，且是 VS Code Pets 基準能力（非加分項）。

唯一值得記錄但不足以推翻 finding 的一點：docs/FEATURES.md:159 把交付範圍寫成「最多 3 隻使魔互相注意／打招呼／追逐，主角會回看」——這說明「主角只回看、不主動」是團隊刻意的、有文件記載的實作範圍，且有回歸測試釘住這個方向性（regressions-phase7.test.ts:391-404、regressions-run2-companion.test.ts:369-389 都只測「使魔→主角」單向，沒有反向測試）。也就是說這不是「漏掉沒發現」的意外 bug，而是團隊已知且刻意選定的範圍。但這個文件記載本身出現在 FEATURES.md 的功能摘要句，不是 docs/acceptance-evidence.md／CHANGELOG 的「已知限制」揭露格式（CLAUDE.md 明確要求已知限制記在這兩處），finding 對「acceptance-evidence.md 已知限制第 8 項沒涵蓋」的查核也屬實。所以就 repo 自訂的「已知限制需在 acceptance-evidence.md/CHANGELOG 揭露」規則而言，這確實是一個真實、可驗證、且未被正式揭露為已知限制的規格落差——finding 站得住腳，medium 嚴重度合理（是體驗/規格符合度落差，不涉及安全或誠實階梯不變量）。

confirmed.fix: 在 `stepChar` 的 `free` 分支加入一個以 familiars 為目標的 hazard 抽樣（新增 `greet-familiar`／`chase-familiar` 模式：走近、停下、冒愛心、偶爾互追），沿用既有的 canPlay 閘門與冷卻；或在 CHANGELOG／acceptance-evidence 誠實記為已知限制（目前兩處都沒有）。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在 world 中放一隻靜止的使魔（無 sleep）與主角，跑多幀直到 `stepFamiliars` 抽樣不到 greet／chase 分支也不觸發；斷言：多次執行不會有任何一次 `char.mode` 因為使魔而非玩具被設成非 free（或新增一個 char 主動 attendTo 使魔的分支後，斷言 `char.targetFamiliar`/`char.mode==="chase"` 且目標是某 familiar id 時能成立）——目前程式碼下此斷言必然失敗，證明「主角不會主動接近/追逐使魔」。

confirmed.title: stand↔sit 姿勢硬切造成 10.00px 單幀頭部瞬移，影響 8 個常駐 ambient 表情
confirmed.claim: blendPose 明確排除不含 lie 的姿勢切換（註解：「stand↔sit 只差 10px，硬切看不出來」），但 layoutFor 的 sit 版面整體下移 10px，且 lerpParams 的字串通道在 ease 中點硬切，實測 idle→sit 的頭中心在單幀從 hy=46.00 跳到 56.00（Δ=10.00px）。128px 邏輯畫布上，站姿頭頂到地面只有 78px，10px 是 13%；scale=2 時等於一幀內位移 20 CSS px。受影響的是 Director 最常排的休息類 ambient：sit、doze、legswing、tailhug、caught-slacking、await-player、player-back、quiet 全部量到 10.00px。專案自己對 lie 過場的回歸門檻是 <12px，這條被排除的路徑就貼在門檻上而且完全沒有測試覆蓋。
confirmed.evidence: params.ts:392-393 `if (from.pose === to.pose) return params; if (from.pose !== "lie" && to.pose !== "lie") return params;`；draw.ts:52-57 `const drop = sit ? 10 : crouch ? 6 : 0; hy: 46 + drop`；draw.ts:91-100 layoutFor 只有 pose==='lie' 或 poseBlend<1 時才 mixLayout。實測（16.7ms 取樣）idle→sit：+184ms pose=stand hy=46.00 d=0.00 ／ **+200ms pose=sit hy=56.00 d=+10.00** ／ +217ms hy=56.00 d=0.00。單一表情內部掃描（setAnimation 後 6 秒）最大單幀位移：sit/doze/legswing/tailhug/caught-slacking/await-player/player-back/quiet 皆為 10.00px @200ms。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自讀了 params.ts 與 draw.ts、timeline.ts 三個檔案，並用專案既有的 ExpressionTimeline/layoutFor（同一套 vitest 環境，非我編造的模型）寫最小重現腳本驗證：

1. 程式碼結構完全如 claim 所述：
   - params.ts:392-393 `blendPose` 明確排除非 lie 的姿勢切換（`if (from.pose !== "lie" && to.pose !== "lie") return params;`），註解「stand↔sit 只差 10px，硬切看不出來」。
   - draw.ts:56-59 `uprightLayout` 對 sit 有 `drop=10`，`hy: 46 + drop`；draw.ts:91-100 `layoutFor` 只在 pose==='lie' 或 poseBlend<1（且該次混合只由 blendPose 驅動）時才 `mixLayout`，非 lie 切換時直接回傳 `uprightLayout(p.pose, pal)`。
   - timeline.ts:401-421：`lerpParams`（字串通道在 t>=0.5 硬切，params.ts:341-343 `out[key] = tt >= 0.5 ? bv : av`）先決定 `pose` 欄位；`blendPose` 只在 `kp<1` 視窗內覆寫，但對非 lie 配對回傳未修改的 params——所以 stand↔sit 完全沒有任何通道在做連續混合。

2. 用專案既有 `ExpressionTimeline` + `layoutFor`（與 regressions-phase7.test.ts 同一組 API，非自造）寫重現腳本（跑在 `apps/interaction-desktop` 的 vitest，之後已刪除，未留痕跡）：
   - idle→sit 逐幀掃描，輸出與 finding 的 evidence 逐字相符：
     `+184ms pose=stand hy=46.00 d=0.00` / `+200ms pose=sit hy=56.00 d=10.00` / `+217ms pose=sit hy=56.00 d=0.00`。
   - 對 8 個表情（sit/doze/legswing/tailhug/caught-slacking/await-player/player-back/quiet）分別跑 idle→該表情 6 秒掃描，全部量到 `maxJump=10.00 at t+200.4ms`，與 claim 完全一致。
   - 逐一確認這 8 個表情的 `hold`/keyframe 都是 `pose: "sit"`（expressions.ts 對應行號），idle 是 `pose: "stand"`，故切換屬於 claim 描述的 stand↔sit 路徑。

3. 測試覆蓋確認：`grep` 全部含 `layoutFor` 的測試檔（regressions-phase7.test.ts、regressions-run2-companion.test.ts），只有一則 `blendPose(stand, sit, sit, 0.2).pose` 的行為斷言（確認「不插值」是刻意設計），沒有任何測試對 stand↔sit 的實際 `layoutFor` 頭部像素跳動量做斷言；唯一的 `<12px` 回歸門檻（regressions-phase7.test.ts:897）只涵蓋 lie↔stand 過場，不含 stand↔sit。這與 claim「完全沒有測試覆蓋」一致。

10px 是刻意的設計選擇（有一則行為測試＋註解佐證是 deliberate），但 claim 本身沒有主張這是未預期的 bug，而是主張：這個刻意排除的路徑造成一幀 10px（scale=2 時 20 CSS px）的頭部瞬移、影響 8 個常駐 ambient 表情、且緊貼專案自訂的 12px 回歸門檻卻無測試覆蓋——這些具體、可驗證的事實全部成立。

confirmed.fix: 把 blendPose 的條件由「是否為 lie」改為「兩個 layout 的 hy 差是否 > 阈值（例如 3px）」，讓 stand↔sit、stand↔crouch 也走連續 poseBlend；mixLayout 的另一端要用實際的來源姿勢而不是硬寫 stand。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在 regressions-phase7.test.ts 仿照既有「lie-flat → idle 連續兩幀頭部 y 位移 < 12px」測試，新增一則對 idle→sit（或 8 個 ambient 表情之一）跑 `ExpressionTimeline.paramsAt` + `layoutFor` 逐幀掃描，斷言 `maxJump < 12`（目前會在 200ms 附近量到 10.00 而非失敗，因為根本沒人寫這個斷言）——藉此把這條刻意排除的路徑的位移量鎖進回歸門檻，未來若 drop 值加大會被抓到。

confirmed.title: clear-transient 的安全白名單漏掉 requesting-consent：runtime 真的在等使用者確認時，連戳角色或 presentation cancel 就把「在等你確認」的真相狀態抹掉
confirmed.claim: machine.ts:157 的 SAFETY_TRANSIENTS 只有 blocked/failed/unknown，沒有 requesting-consent。因此非 force 的 clear-transient（reduce() case "clear-transient", machine.ts:278-283）會清掉正在台上的 requesting-consent（ask 姿勢）。這條路有三個實際觸發點，其中「連戳角色」完全本機、不需要任何競態：CompanionApp.tsx:1746 的連戳分支先 apply({type:"clear-transient"}) 再套 performing，繞過 PRIORITY 階梯（requesting-consent 80 vs performing 25，正常競爭本來會 keep）。結果是 runtime 仍在 waiting-consent／waiting-input，角色卻已回到玩鬧姿勢，送回 runtime 的 rollCall 也從「在等你確認」變成 null（CompanionApp.tsx:1163 只在 t.kind 非 performing 時給標籤）。專案內部對這個狀態的定位是明確的安全類：behavior.ts:189 把 CLASS_OF 的 "waiting-confirmation"（machine.ts:73 = requesting-consent）算成 isSafety「安全事件永不歸零」；rig/expressions.ts:1090 的 ask 標 truthState:true 並註明「代表 runtime 真的在等 consent／輸入」；intent.rs:149 給 RequestConsent floor 80。只有 machine.ts 的 SAFETY_TRANSIENTS 與它們不一致。
confirmed.evidence:
machine.ts:157 `const SAFETY_TRANSIENTS = new Set<TransientKind>(["blocked", "failed", "unknown"]);`
machine.ts:281 `if (!event.force && t && t.untilMs > nowMs && SAFETY_TRANSIENTS.has(t.kind)) return state;`
CompanionApp.tsx:1745-1748 連戳分支：`if (plan.kind === "rapid") { apply({ type: "clear-transient" }); apply({ type: "transient", kind: "performing", ... }); return; }`
CompanionApp.tsx:1077 presentation cancel：`if (cancelPlan.transient === null) apply({ type: "clear-transient", force: effects.forceClear });`（cancelEffects("cancel") → forceClear:false，presentationCommands.ts:80-84）
CompanionApp.tsx:1090 舊 daemon 路徑 animation-play "idle"/"quiet"（PLAYABLE_ART 中 art===null）→ `apply({ type: "clear-transient" })`，同樣不帶 force，且 companion.animation.play 是 AI 可呼叫的 actuator。
對比證據（behavior.ts:189）`const isSafety = cls === "emergency" || cls === "sensor-safety" || cls === "waiting-confirmation";` 與 machine.ts:73 `"requesting-consent": "waiting-confirmation"`。
實測（把未修改的 machine.ts／presentationCommands.ts 複製到 scratchpad 用 node --experimental-strip-types 跑）：
  before: {"kind":"requesting-consent","untilMs":1012000} → pose { animation: 'ask', ambient: false }
  plan: {"outcome":"completed","transient":null,"bubble":null} effects: {"forceClear":false}
  after cancel: null → pose { animation: 'idle', ambient: true }
  blocked after cancel: {"kind":"blocked","untilMs":1004500}（對照組沒被清掉）
CHANGELOG.md 與 docs/acceptance-evidence.md grep 「requesting-consent／clear-transient／SAFETY_TRANSIENTS」皆 0 筆，未列為已知限制。

verdicts.reasoning:
All claims verified against current source, not stale.

1. machine.ts:157 `SAFETY_TRANSIENTS = new Set(["blocked", "failed", "unknown"])` — confirmed exact text, `requesting-consent` absent.
2. machine.ts:281 `if (!event.force && t && t.untilMs > nowMs && SAFETY_TRANSIENTS.has(t.kind)) return state;` — confirmed exact text.
3. Independent repro (not the finding's own script — I rewrote it from scratch against untouched copies of machine.ts/behavior.ts, only patching import specifiers to run standalone under `node --experimental-strip-types`):
   - before: `{"kind":"requesting-consent","untilMs":1000000,"animation":"ask"}`
   - `reduce(s, {type:"clear-transient"}, now)` (no force) → transient `null`
   - control `blocked` under the identical non-force clear-transient → survives (`{"kind":"blocked",...}`)
   This proves the asymmetry is real in the actual `reduce()` logic, not an artifact of the finding's harness.
4. Three call sites confirmed verbatim:
   - CompanionApp.tsx:1077 `if (cancelPlan.transient === null) apply({ type: "clear-transient", force: effects.forceClear });` inside the AI-reachable `command === "cancel"` branch; `cancelEffects("cancel")` (presentationCommands.ts:82-83) returns `forceClear: false`.
   - CompanionApp.tsx:1090 `if (plan.transient === null) apply({ type: "clear-transient" });` — legacy non-CPP `state-present`/`animation-play` path (companion.animation.play actuator, AI-reachable), no force.
   - CompanionApp.tsx:1745-1747 rapid-click branch: `apply({ type: "clear-transient" })` then `apply({ type: "transient", kind: "performing", ... })`, no force, entirely local/no race needed.
5. behavior.ts:189 `isSafety = cls === "emergency" || cls === "sensor-safety" || cls === "waiting-confirmation"` and machine.ts CLASS_OF `"requesting-consent": "waiting-confirmation"` — confirmed; the project's own scoring logic treats this class as "safety-never-zeroes" but the transient-clearing gate doesn't.
6. intent.rs:149 `CharacterIntent::RequestConsent => 80` (priority floor) and expressions.ts:1086-1090 `ask` truthState:true — confirmed, both corroborate requesting-consent's intended safety-tier status.
7. CompanionApp.tsx:537 comment `"給 adapter 的混音器入口：intent 演出與本機互動在同一台 machine 上競爭"` confirms local interactions (rapid click) and intent-driven state (agent-session waiting-consent, CPP ask) share the exact same mutable machine state, so the local bypass really can stomp a genuine runtime-driven consent wait.
8. machine.ts:1163-ish rollCall mapping: `t == null || t.kind === "performing" ? null : {..., "requesting-consent": "在等你確認", ...}[t.kind]` — confirmed; clearing the transient really does drop the human-readable "waiting for your confirmation" label to null/ambient.
9. Existing regression test (regressions-run2-companion.test.ts, "director-pipeline-022：cancel 不清安全訊息") only iterates `["blocked","failed","unknown"]` — proves this exact SAFETY_TRANSIENTS mechanism was purpose-built for a prior finding but the scope was never extended to requesting-consent; no test anywhere asserts requesting-consent survives non-force clear-transient.
10. grep for "requesting-consent"/"SAFETY_TRANSIENTS" in CHANGELOG.md and docs/acceptance-evidence.md returns zero hits — not documented as a known limitation.

This is a real, reachable gap: a non-force clear-transient (from the AI-callable presentation `cancel`/legacy `animation-play idle` actuators, or from a purely local rapid double-click) silently wipes a genuine `requesting-consent` transient that may be reflecting the runtime's real waiting-for-user-consent state (driven by `agent.session.state` "waiting-consent"/"waiting-input" events sharing the same machine, per CompanionApp.tsx:537's own comment), producing a false "not waiting" UI/rollCall state while the runtime is still actually blocked pending consent. This is a genuine honesty-ladder / "sensing must not go silent" violation for a state the codebase's own classification (behavior.ts, intent.rs, expressions.ts) treats as safety-tier. Severity medium is appropriate: it doesn't bypass the Rust Policy Governor's actual enforcement (the runtime's real wait state is untouched), but it does make the companion UI dishonestly show "not waiting for you" while it truly is, which is exactly the class of defect this project's invariants call out.

confirmed.fix: 把 "requesting-consent" 加進 machine.ts:157 的 SAFETY_TRANSIENTS（它同時也讓 estop 進場時不再保留它——需另行決定：estop 時本來就該清掉，可改成兩個集合：CLEAR_PROTECTED = blocked/failed/unknown/requesting-consent 給 clear-transient 用，ESTOP_KEEP = blocked/failed/unknown 給 base:emergency 用）。連戳分支（CompanionApp.tsx:1746）不要先 clear-transient，改成讓 transientCompetition 的優先階梯決定（performing 25 本來就搶不過 80）；若確實需要清掉自己的 ambient，改成只在目前 transient.kind === "performing" 時清。並補一條回歸：requesting-consent 在台上時，連戳與 presentation cancel 都不得把它清掉。
confirmed.regressionTest: In machine.ts's reduce(): seed state with an active `requesting-consent` transient (untilMs in the future), call `reduce(s, {type:"clear-transient"}, now)` with no `force`, and assert `result.transient?.kind === "requesting-consent"` (mirroring the existing `for (const kind of ["blocked","failed","unknown"])` loop in regressions-run2-companion.test.ts but adding `"requesting-consent"` to that list) — plus an end-to-end CompanionApp test asserting the rapid-click branch and the `cancel` presentation-command branch do not clear an active requesting-consent transient.

confirmed.title: on_receipt 丟棄 adapter 誠實回報的降級 resolution，回執出現 status=unsupported 但 resolution=exact
confirmed.claim: §7 規定回執的 resolution「只能比協商結果更差」，程式碼註解也寫「unsupported 更差 → 採用」，但 `.filter(|r| *r <= Resolution::Reduced)` 把 adapter 回報的 `Unsupported`／`Failed` 過濾掉，改用協商當時的值。結果 Gateway 對外發出自相矛盾且偏樂觀的回執（狀態說沒演成、resolution 說 exact），Runtime 的 audit／`character.receipt` 事件因此高估實際呈現品質。TS 端行為相反（`p.effective = worse(...)` 會採用 unsupported），兩份實作對同一輸入產生不同回執。
confirmed.evidence: gateway.rs:1112-1120：`let effective_resolution = if receipt.status == ReceiptStatus::Failed { Resolution::Failed } else { receipt.resolution.filter(|r| *r <= Resolution::Reduced).map_or(negotiated_resolution, |r| r.max(negotiated_resolution)) };`，其中 capability.rs:342-348 的 Ord 為 `Exact < Substituted < Reduced < Unsupported < Failed`。實跑探針：協商 exact 的 `notice`，adapter 回 `{status:Started, resolution:Unsupported}` → `RECEIPT m4 status=Started res=Some(Exact)`；回 `{status:Unsupported, resolution:Unsupported}` → `RECEIPT s1 status=Unsupported resolution=Some(Exact)`。tests/gateway.rs:1437 的註解宣稱涵蓋此情境，但該測試只斷言了 substituted 的情況，沒有實際驗 unsupported。對照 apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/gateway.ts:1111-1113（`worse()` + `if (status === "unsupported") p.effective = "unsupported"`）。

verdicts.reasoning: Reproduced live against current source (crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs, lines 1112-1122 unchanged from cited 1112-1120). Added a temporary integration test exercising Gateway::on_receipt with an adapter honestly reporting {status: Unsupported, resolution: Unsupported} (and separately {status: Started, resolution: Unsupported}) after a negotiation that resolved to Exact. Actual output receipts: `status=Unsupported, resolution=Some(Exact)` and `status=Started, resolution=Some(Exact)` — exactly matching the finding's quoted probe output. Root cause confirmed: `.filter(|r| *r <= Resolution::Reduced)` at line 1117 drops any adapter-reported Unsupported/Failed resolution unless receipt.status is literally ReceiptStatus::Failed (a different enum from Resolution::Failed), silently reverting effective_resolution to the negotiated (better) value. This produces a self-contradictory receipt (status says nothing was presented, resolution says it was exact) which violates the project's core honesty-ladder invariant (unknown/degraded results must not be reported as better than they are) and contradicts the code's own comment claiming 'unsupported 更差 → 採用'. Verified the cited test (tests/gateway.rs receipt_resolution_may_degrade_but_never_upgrade, lines 1408-1475) only asserts Exact (ignored) and Substituted (adopted) cases — it never actually sends an Unsupported resolution despite the in-test comment claiming to cover it, so this gap is untested. Cross-checked apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/gateway.ts:1111-1113, which unconditionally forces p.effective = "unsupported" when status === "unsupported" (in addition to worse()), confirming the TS and Rust implementations genuinely diverge on identical input as claimed. Temporary probe test file was deleted after verification; git status on the test directory is clean, no repo files were left modified.

confirmed.fix: 把 filter 改成只擋「比協商結果更好」的值（`r.max(negotiated_resolution)` 已足夠），讓 Unsupported／Failed 直接被採用；並在 tests/gateway.rs 針對 status=unsupported 補 `assert_eq!(resolution, Some(Resolution::Unsupported))`。
confirmed.regressionTest: In Gateway::on_receipt, dispatch an Exact-capable intent, then feed a receipt with status=Unsupported (or Started) and resolution=Some(Unsupported) directly (bypassing the Failed-status special case); assert the emitted CommandReceipt.resolution equals Unsupported (or at least > negotiated), not the pre-negotiation Exact value — i.e. extend receipt_resolution_may_degrade_but_never_upgrade with an actual Unsupported-resolution case instead of only asserting it in a comment.

confirmed.title: AI 呈現命令由「任一角色實例最先回的終態回執」結案，外部 adapter 可代桌面角色決定結果
confirmed.claim: `character_ai_present` 對所有已連線 instance 用同一個 messageId（= actionId）派送，而 `take_ai_command` 是 remove 語意：第一個回終態回執的 instance 就結算該 presentation action，其餘 instance 的回執一律被丟成「already settled」。只持有 adapter token 的第三方外部 adapter（role familiar）因此能替桌面角色把 AI 的 `companion.state.present`／`animation.play` 標成 completed（桌面其實還沒演或演失敗），或反過來搶先回 unsupported／failed 把成功的呈現記成失敗。§8.2 明訂 adapter token「不能呼叫 actuator」，這條路徑等於讓它決定 actuator receipt 的終態。
confirmed.evidence: character.rs:1705-1735 `let message_id = action_id.clone();` 後 `for id in &targets { ... gw.dispatch(&InstanceId(id.clone()), envelope, now) }`，targets 來自 character.rs:548-555 `connected_instance_ids()`（只過濾 connected+negotiated，不分 role）。character.rs:684-689 `fn take_ai_command(...) { let taken = guard.by_message.remove(message_id)?; ... }`。character.rs:1838-1850：`if receipt.is_terminal() { if let Some((action_id, _command)) = hub.take_ai_command(&receipt.message_id) { settlements.push(Settlement { outcome: settlement_outcome(receipt.status), ... }) } }`。character.rs:1905-1913 顯示後到的結算被吞成 debug log「presentation command already settled or expired」。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自逐行核對，主張的機制完全成立，且驗證到比 finding 引用更深一層的因果鏈：

1. `character_ai_present`（character.rs:1672-1738，`let message_id = action_id.clone();` 在 1704 行）對 `hub.connected_instance_ids()`（548-555 行，僅過濾 `connected && negotiated`，**不分 role**）回傳的每個 target 呼叫 `gw.dispatch(&InstanceId(id.clone()), envelope, now)`（1734 行），所有 target 共用同一個 `message_id = action_id`。

2. `animation_projection`/`behavior_intent_projection`（1672 行呼叫點的兩個分支）產出的 intent 一律非 safety（`ai_substitution_never_yields_a_safety_intent` 測試背書），因此 gateway.rs:753-763 的「多實例安全去重」（僅套用在 `envelope.intent.is_safety()`）完全不適用——非安全 AI 呈現命令會不受抑制地廣播給所有已協商 instance，包含 role=familiar 的外部 adapter。

3. `remember_ai_command`/`take_ai_command`（667-688 行）把這次 presentation 命令記在 `CharacterHub.ai_commands.by_message: BTreeMap<String, AiCommand>`（134 行），**純用 message_id 當 key，完全沒有 instance/role 維度**——即便 Gateway 內部的 pending/terminal 狀態是 per-instance（`instances: BTreeMap<InstanceId, InstanceState>`，gateway.rs:268），Hub 這層的「誰能結案」判斷卻是全域單一名額。

4. 兩種 instance 回傳終態回執走的是**同一條**函式：外部 adapter 經 `POST /v1/character/receipts`（受 `enforce_character_instance` 限制只能替自己 instance 說話，但這本身合法——它就是被廣播到的合法收件者）、桌面視窗經 Tauri IPC `character_bridge.rs:81` `rt.character_receipt(instance_id, receipt)`——兩者都導向同一個 `Runtime::character_receipt`（924 行起）→ `apply_character_outputs`（`GatewayOutput::Receipt` 分支，1842 行 `hub.take_ai_command(&receipt.message_id)` 精確命中 finding 引用行號）→ 第一個到達者呼叫 `presentation_ack` 把**持久化的 ActionReceipt**（AI 實際查得到的 completed/failed 狀態）寫成終態；`take_pending` 是 remove 語意，第二個到達的終態回執在 `settle_character_receipts`（1905-1913 行，`DomainError::NotFound` 分支）被吞成 debug log「presentation command already settled or expired」，不再影響已持久化的 receipt。

5. §8.2（docs/character-protocol/README.md:284-286）明文：adapter token「不能呼叫 actuator」。但上述機制讓一個只有 adapter token 的外部 familiar-role adapter，只要對同一個 messageId 搶先回終態回執，就能決定桌面 companion actuator（`companion.state.present`／`animation.play`）在 AI 眼中的 completed/failed/unsupported 結果——這正是它被明文禁止碰的 actuator receipt 終態決定權。此路徑不需任何額外漏洞，只需已註冊的合法 adapter 對已收到的合法廣播提早回覆，即可穩定命中競態（外部 adapter 通常比桌面真的播放完動畫快得多）。

引用行號與現況幾乎完全吻合（character.rs:1842 精確命中；548-555、684-689 精確命中；1705/1734 與引用的 1705-1735 相差 1 行內，屬敘述性範圍非漂移）。未找到任何測試覆蓋此 race（character.rs 內建 `mod tests` 與 `presentation_loop.rs` 均未涉及多 instance 廣播+搶先回執情境），也未見任何 role 優先權或 primary-companion 專屬結算邏輯可反駁此主張。判定：confirmed，維持 medium（需要一個已被人類 token 註冊過的外部 adapter 才能觸發，非匿名外部可直接打，但一旦註冊即可穩定重現，且違反明文的 adapter 權限邊界）。

confirmed.fix: 把 AI command 的追蹤鍵改成 (messageId, instanceId)，只讓桌面 primary-companion（或發起該 actuator 的表面）的回執推進 presentation receipt；其他 instance 的回執只進 audit／事件。或改成「等所有目標終態後彙總，任一 uncertain 即記 uncertain」。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在測試中對同一 `action_id`／`companion.state.present` 讓 desktop 與一個已註冊 role=familiar 的外部 adapter 同時 connected+negotiated；先由外部 adapter 對該 messageId 回 `ReceiptStatus::Completed`（經 `hub.character_receipt` 或等效路徑），斷言 `presentation_ack` 已把該 action 的持久化 `ActionReceipt` 寫成 completed；接著讓桌面對同一 messageId 回 `ReceiptStatus::Failed`，斷言該筆真正的失敗回執被吞（`take_ai_command` 回 None／`settle_character_receipts` 落入 NotFound debug 分支），且持久化 receipt 仍停留在外部 adapter 搶先寫入的 completed，而非反映桌面的真實失敗結果。

confirmed.title: 外部 adapter 的輸入事件繞過桌面表面閘門，卻寫進同一組 companion.* 受器並解除主動對話的未回覆守則
confirmed.claim: `character_input_to_observation` 對 external origin 直接關掉表面閘門（`enforce_surface_gate = origin != InstanceOrigin::External`），但事件仍被寫進 `companion.click`／`companion.text-input`／`companion.quick-action`／`companion.drag-drop`／`companion.pointer` 這些「隱藏角色即停用」的表面受器。結果：桌面角色已隱藏／視窗已關（UI 與 status 宣稱其視窗內感官已停止）時，只持有 adapter token 的第三方 adapter 仍可持續產生這些受器的 observation，並因此觸發 `proactive_note_reply()`（把「使用者其實沒回」偽裝成回覆，解除不追問守則）與 `evaluate_recipes()`。這牴觸「隱藏角色停用視窗內受器」的確定性承諾與誠實階梯（非人類輸入被當成人類互動）。
confirmed.evidence: character.rs:2116-2118 `// 桌面角色的視窗內受器受隱藏／斷線閘門管制；外部 adapter 沒有桌面表面。 let enforce_surface_gate = origin != InstanceOrigin::External; self.ingest_with_gate(receptor, facts, ...)`；受器 id 由同函式 2009-2099 產生，全部是 companion.* 表面受器。presentation.rs:915-927 `is_companion_surface_receptor` 明列這些 id；runtime.rs:617-624 只有在 `enforce_surface_gate` 為 true 時才回 `Unavailable("companion window hidden or not connected; its receptors are stopped")`。runtime.rs:645-654：命中 companion.click／text-input／quick-action／drag-drop 即呼叫 `self.proactive_note_reply()`；656 行接著 `self.evaluate_recipes(Some(receptor_id))`。外部 adapter 走 routes.rs:1716 `character_events`（lib.rs:395-401 adapter token 明確允許此路由）即可送達。

verdicts.reasoning:
逐行追蹤驗證，claim 完全成立，且比原敘述能挖出更精確的機制：

1. character.rs:2116-2118（行號無漂移）：`enforce_surface_gate = origin != InstanceOrigin::External`，外部 origin 一律關閉表面閘門。
2. character.rs:2009-2099 產生的 receptor id 全部是 `companion.click`／`companion.text-input`／`companion.quick-action`／`companion.drag-drop`／`companion.pointer`，presentation.rs:915-927 `is_companion_surface_receptor` 明列同一組 id——桌面與外部 adapter 共用「同一個」receptor 實例，不是各自獨立的表面。
3. runtime.rs:617-624：只有 `enforce_surface_gate=true` 才在視窗隱藏時擋下 push（回 Unavailable）；為 false 時直接放行到 `receptor.push()`（runtime.rs:633）。
4. runtime.rs:645-654／656：命中這幾個 receptor id 即呼叫 `proactive_note_reply()`（把 `last_answered` 設 true，解除 proactive.rs:197 的「未回覆不追問」抑制）並 `evaluate_recipes()`。
5. 呼叫鏈已證實可達：adapter token 只能打 `POST /v1/character/receipts|events`（lib.rs:395-401）且被 `enforce_character_instance` 限制在自己的 `adapter:<id>` instance（routes.rs:1691-1697,1713-1721）；`character_adapter_add`／`character_ws_attach` 註冊的 instance 明確是 `InstanceOrigin::External`（character.rs:1273），因此 `character_event`（970-1010）與 `character_ws_message`（1371）都是以 `InstanceOrigin::External` 呼叫 `character_input_to_observation`。
6. 更關鍵的獨立證據鏈——這條 receptor 的 `health()` 綁的正是同一個桌面 `PresentationBridge`（presentation.rs:834-838 `presentation_receptors` 用 `bridge.receptor_health`），隱藏時回 `ComponentHealth::offline("companion window hidden or not connected")`（presentation.rs:376-382）。這個 health 經 `interaction-registry` 的 `refresh_health`／`receptor_manifests`／`availability_of`（registry lib.rs:311,143-149,369-376）映射成 `Availability::Offline`，會出現在 discovery snapshot 給 AI／CLI／UI 看。`adapters/builtin/src/receptors.rs:38-41` 的 doc comment明講 `with_health` 的目的就是「the registry never pretends it can observe」。
   但 external-origin 的 push 完全不受這個 health 狀態約束（health 只是展示欄位，實際擋是 `ingest_with_gate` 裡另一條獨立判斷，且該判斷對 External 被跳過）。於是出現可證明的矛盾：status／snapshot 對外回報 `companion.click` 等 receptor 為 Offline「隱藏或未連線」，實際上該 receptor 仍在吃外部 adapter 的資料並驅動真實副作用（解除追問守則＋觸發 recipes）——這正是「感測不靜默」（狀態要如實反映啟用中的感測）與誠實階梯（不可用未驗證輸入冒充已回覆／已驗證狀態）的具體違反，而不只是「風格」或「已知取捨」。
7. 找不到任何既有測試涵蓋這個交互（character.rs 測試模組只測純函式 manifest 能力，未涉及 InstanceOrigin::External 與 surface gate 的交互），也找不到 CHANGELOG／acceptance-evidence 把這個行為記成已知限制。runtime.rs:594-596 的註解只承認「policy／consent 仍然適用」，並未處理 health/availability 與實際行為不一致的問題，說明作者當時只考慮了闔上安全閘門是否必要，沒考慮到共用同一 receptor id 造成的狀態失真。

結論：claim 準確、證據確鑿，且我能補上一條原 finding 沒明講但同樣成立、更硬的獨立證據（receptor health/availability 的 Offline 回報與外部 adapter 仍在寫入該 receptor 之間的矛盾），足以支持 confirmed=true。severity medium 合理（非可繞過身分驗證的越權，而是狀態失真＋政策狀態被非桌面來源的輸入解除，影響誠實階梯與感測不靜默兩個明確不變量，但攻擊面被 adapter token 的 instance-scope 限制住，不到 high/blocker）。

confirmed.fix: 外部 instance 的輸入改寫入獨立受器（例如 `character.external.click`／`character.external.text-input`）或在 facts 加上不可偽造的 `origin: "external-adapter"`，並讓 `proactive_note_reply()` 只接受 origin 為可信 host 的互動；同時在 status／UI 顯示外部角色仍在送輸入，維持「感測不靜默」。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在測試 runtime 中：註冊一個桌面 character（hello, visible=false 或不 hello），另外用 `character_adapter_add`＋`character_ws_attach`／`character_event` 對同一 instance 送一則 `companion.click`（TextSubmitted 亦可）；斷言 (a) 呼叫成功回 `InputOutcome::Observed` 而非 `Unavailable`，(b) 呼叫前後 `registry.receptor_manifests()` 中 `companion.click` 的 `availability` 仍是 `Offline`（因為只看桌面 bridge），(c) 呼叫後 `proactive_dialogue.last_answered == true`——三者同時成立即證明「status 說 Offline，但這個 receptor 剛剛真的觀察到一筆並解除了未回覆守則」。

confirmed.title: 活動紀錄收件匣在一般模式直接印出原始裝置／受器識別碼
