confirmed.title: Reduced Motion 不是文件宣稱的「真靜態」：8 個表情在 reduced 下仍每 2.2–5.4 秒自動眨眼
confirmed.claim: paramsAt 的自動眨眼區塊只看 `this.expr.autoBlink`，沒有被 `!this.reducedMotion` 包住（enter/loop/exit/crossfade/微動作/粒子都有被關掉）。Reduced Motion 下 idle、sit、lie-flat、spaced-out、legswing、tailhug、await-player、quiet 這 8 個表情仍會週期性把 eyeOpen 從 1.0 壓到 0.05 再回來（150ms 一次、間隔 2.2–5.4 s）。timeline.ts 檔頭自己寫「Reduced Motion：只保留 hold（無 enter/loop/exit）」，docs/DESKTOP-GUIDE.md:324「真靜態，不是慢動作」、docs/v05-phase7-final-report.md:96「Reduced Motion 真靜態」、docs/v05-capability-gap-matrix.md:120「執行中可切換、真靜態」都與實際行為不符。
confirmed.evidence: timeline.ts:440-454 `if (this.expr.autoBlink) { if (now >= this.nextBlinkAt) {…} … params = clampParams({ ...params, eyeOpen: params.eyeOpen * (1 - dip * 0.95) }) }`（對照 :364 particles 歸零、:393 target=base、:407 略過 crossfade、:416 略過 blendPose、:424 略過微動作都有 reducedMotion 守門）。實測 setReducedMotion(true)+setAnimation("idle")，20 秒掃描唯一會變動的通道是 eyeOpen（最大變化 0.95）：3800ms:1.000 → 3817:0.788 → 3834:0.577 → 3850:0.365 → 3867:0.154。autoBlink 表情清單：idle,sit,lie-flat,spaced-out,legswing,tailhug,await-player,quiet。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified by direct code reading and empirical reproduction.

1. Code inspection (timeline.ts:440-454, current file): the autoBlink block in `paramsAt()` is guarded only by `if (this.expr.autoBlink)` — no `!this.reducedMotion` check, unlike every other animated block in the same function (particles at :364 `if (this.reducedMotion)`, exit playback at :370 `if (!this.reducedMotion && now < this.exiting.until)`, target selection at :393 `if (this.reducedMotion) target = base`, crossfade at :407 `k >= 1 || this.reducedMotion`, pose/arm blend at :416 `if (!this.reducedMotion)`, micro-overlay at :424 `if (!this.reducedMotion && ...)`). The blink block runs unconditionally whenever `this.expr.autoBlink` is true and the expression isn't in `FROZEN_EXPRESSIONS` (emergency/offline/paused — checked earlier at line ~386, before the reducedMotion-gated sections).

2. Confirmed all 8 named expressions (idle, sit, lie-flat, spaced-out, legswing, tailhug, await-player, quiet) have `autoBlink: true` in expressions.ts (lines 81, 111, 125, 291, 298, 311, 872, 1309), and none of them are in FROZEN_EXPRESSIONS or PREEMPTING_EXPRESSIONS, so the guard-less blink block is reachable for all of them.

3. Empirical repro: wrote a throwaway vitest test that constructs `ExpressionTimeline`, calls `setReducedMotion(true)`, `setAnimation("idle", 0)`, then samples `paramsAt(t)` every 17ms for 20 seconds. Result: `eyeOpen` is the *only* param that changes at all (all other channels frozen as claimed), ranging from 1.0 down to ~0.139 — i.e., periodic blinking still fires under Reduced Motion. Test file was deleted after verification; no repo files were modified.

4. Confirmed `setReducedMotion` is wired to the real `prefers-reduced-motion` media query in CompanionApp.tsx:812/820 — not dead/unused code.

5. Confirmed the three doc citations exist verbatim: docs/DESKTOP-GUIDE.md:324 "真靜態，不是慢動作", docs/v05-phase7-final-report.md:96 "Reduced Motion 真靜態", docs/v05-capability-gap-matrix.md:120 "真靜態" — all contradicted by the actual behavior. The file's own header comment (timeline.ts:14) also states "Reduced Motion：只保留 hold（無 enter/loop/exit）" without mentioning blink as an exception, and no code comment documents blink as an intentional exemption from Reduced Motion.

6. Checked for existing test coverage that might already guard this: no test asserts eyeOpen stays constant under reducedMotion+autoBlink expressions; the one existing "quiet" blink test (regressions-phase7.test.ts:510) doesn't set reducedMotion at all, so it doesn't cover this gap.

No sign of a parallel fix already landing (checked current file content directly, git status shows this file clean/untouched in this working tree). Severity "low" from the finding is reasonable — it's an accessibility/documentation-accuracy issue (small motion, not a safety-critical honesty-ladder violation), so I leave severity as-is.

   If false, code falls through to `apply({type:"transient", kind:"performing", animation: action.expression, ...})` — the exact "one-off general performance" path the adjacent comment (1401-1403) says causes the character to snap from the quiet sitting pose back to a neutral standing pose.

2. director.ts confirms the "blink" string is not an engine constant but adapter-supplied data: `blink: this.tables.blink` (type `{expression:string; durationMs:number}|null`, director.ts:68), and the ambient-blink branch returns `{ expression: blink.expression, durationMs: blink.durationMs, source: "ambient" }` (director.ts:303-305) — i.e. `action.expression` is literally whatever the active adapter's tables.blink.expression is. Director's own file header states the design intent explicitly: "Engine-neutral（CPP）：Director 不認識任何角色的表情 id...全部由角色 adapter 的 DirectorTables 注入" (director.ts:11-14).

3. `DirectorAction.source` is only `"ambient" | "reaction" | "resume"` (director.ts:36) — there is no discriminator field distinguishing "this ambient action is specifically the blink" from any other ambient variant. The *only* signal available to a caller to detect "this is the blink action" is comparing `action.expression` to the adapter's blink id — so CompaningApp.tsx's approach of comparing against a literal is not "one option among several," it's a real architectural gap: nothing engine-neutral exists to check instead.

4. shuTables.ts's own header makes the violation explicit: "這裡是唯一允許出現小樞表情 id 的「行為層」位置...由本檔的表注入" (shuTables.ts:1-4) — the codebase's own contract claims shuTables.ts is the *sole* place shu-specific ids may appear, yet CompanionApp.tsx:1405 independently hardcodes the same value.

5. Confirmed the id is genuinely character-specific, not a reserved protocol/engine name: rig/expressions.ts's file header reads "小樞 v3 表情庫：36 個正式表情" (expressions.ts:1) — "blink" is one of 36 shu-pack expression ids, defined in the pack's own catalog, injected via `SHU_BLINK = { expression: "blink", ... }` (shuTables.ts:89) — coincidence of value, not a shared vocabulary.

6. Confirmed latency (not a live bug today): only one Tables-providing adapter exists — `grep -rn "setTables("` shows CompanionApp.tsx only ever calls `setTables(shu?.directorTables ?? EMPTY_DIRECTOR_TABLES)` (CompanionApp.tsx:982,1015); sprite/text characters get `EMPTY_DIRECTOR_TABLES` (blink: null, director.ts:79), so Director never emits a blink action for them at all today — this branch is unreachable with a mismatched id until a second Tables-providing adapter ships. Matches the finding's own "潛伏缺陷而非現行可見錯誤" framing.

7. Confirmed this is a deliberate (not accidental) piece of code, locked by a source-string regression test: `src/test/regressions-phase7.test.ts:528-532` asserts the file literally contains `'gate.quiet && action.expression === "blink"'`. That test guards the *behavioral* fix (quiet blink must not reset pose) but does not validate engine-neutrality, so it doesn't refute the finding — it just shows the coupling was intentional at the time, without the author having provided a non-string-literal signal for it.

Net: every specific citation in the finding (line numbers, quoted code, director.ts:68/11-14, shuTables.ts:89, CLAUDE.md invariant wording) checks out against the current file contents. The "頁面" framing is apt: CompanionApp.tsx is literally the desktop companion's top-level React root, which is what CLAUDE.md's "Runtime／頁面不得再引用小樞的部位、表情名或 pack id" is aimed at. Severity "low" is accurate: no live incorrect behavior today (only shu ships tables, and only shu's blink id is "blink"), but it's a real, reproducible latent coupling that will silently regress the quiet-hours-blink UX (pose pop back to neutral) the moment a second Tables-providing character adapter is added with a differently-named blink expression — exactly contradicting the adjacent code comment's stated goal.

confirmed.fix: 把 tables 的 blink 表情名帶到 host：例如在 CompanionApp 保存一份 `blinkExprRef`（wireAdapter 時從 `shu?.directorTables.blink?.expression` 取），判斷改成 `gate.quiet && action.expression === blinkExprRef.current`；或更乾淨地讓 DirectorAction 帶一個 `kind: "blink"` 標記，host 只看標記不看 id。
confirmed.regressionTest: Register a second fake DirectorTables (e.g. `{ ...EMPTY_DIRECTOR_TABLES, blink: { expression: "eyes-shut", durationMs: 300 }, ambient: [{expression:"eyes-shut", ...}], isPlayable: () => true }`) as the active character's tables, drive the quiet-hours ambient tick until Director returns that blink action, and assert the companion's pose/base stays at the quiet sitting state (not reset to a neutral "performing" transient) — this fails today only in intent (can't literally fail via the current test harness since no second adapter exists yet), but a unit test directly on the `blinkedInPlace`-equivalent logic extracted with an injectable "current blink expression id" would catch the literal-`"blink"` coupling.

confirmed.title: InteractionDirector.score()（規格 §6 管線的 Utility Scoring 段）是死碼，Director 的決策完全沒有經過效用評分
confirmed.claim: 規格 §6 的 Director 管線是「… → Attention Manager → Character Context → Utility Scoring → Behavior Intent → Action Scheduler → …」，director.ts:185-188 提供 `score(cls, ctx)` 作為這一段的入口，但整個 repo 沒有任何呼叫端。Director 的 tick()／reactDetailed() 只用 hazard 抽樣、冷卻與防重複做決定，完全不看 scoreEvent 的重複懲罰、alreadyResponded、doNotDisturb 或 relevance/novelty。scoreEvent 唯一的真實用途在 machine.ts:151-152 的同優先 transient 平手判定，而那裡的 ctx 是硬寫死的常數（recentSameClass:0、doNotDisturb:false、relevance:1），退化成「同優先一律換人」的固定結果。所以「Interaction Director 具備 Utility Scoring」這個規格項目在實作上沒有落地。

verdicts.reasoning: Full re-verification confirms every factual claim. (1) director.ts:185-188 is exactly the cited comment+method (verified with `sed -n '183,190p' | cat -n`). (2) `grep -rn "\.score(" apps/interaction-desktop/src apps/interaction-desktop/e2e` returns 0 matches — the public score() wrapper has no caller anywhere in the codebase. (3) `grep -rn scoreEvent apps/interaction-desktop/src` returns exactly the 5 locations the finding lists: behavior.ts:182 (definition), director.ts:16/187 (import + dead wrapper), machine.ts:10/151-152 (the sole real call site), and behavior.test.ts (unit tests of the pure function only, not of Director). (4) I read director.ts's full tick() and reactDetailed() bodies end-to-end (the real decision paths): tick() decides via hazard-rate sampling, cooldown maps, playable() whitelist, recent-dedupe, quiet/reducedMotion checks, and interrupted-resume logic; reactDetailed() decides via reactions-table lookup, playable filter, cooldown filter, last-variant anti-repeat, and pretendNotHear roll. Neither calls score() or scoreEvent anywhere in their bodies. (5) machine.ts:143-153 confirms the only genuine scoreEvent usage is transientCompetition's equal-priority tie-break, and its `base` context object hardcodes recentSameClass:0, alreadyResponded:false, interruptible:true, doNotDisturb:false, relevance:1 — none sourced from live DirectorContext/BehaviorState (e.g. DirectorContext.quiet never feeds doNotDisturb) — varying only novelty 0 vs 1 between the active/next calls. (6) docs/specs/...:224-233 literally lists 'Utility Scoring' as a pipeline stage between Character Context and Behavior Intent, matching the finding's quoted spec text. The claim that '規格 §6 的 Director 管線是 Utility Scoring 段沒有落地，Director 的決策完全沒有經過效用評分' holds: the only production decision-making code paths (tick/reactDetailed) never consult scoreEvent, and the one real caller is a degenerate, state-disconnected tie-break rather than the described pipeline stage. This is a reproducible dead-code/spec-fidelity gap, not a functional or safety defect — 'low' severity is appropriate as reported (Director achieves broadly similar outcomes via alternate heuristics; nothing behaves incorrectly or unsafely as a result).

confirmed.fix: 二選一並讓文件與程式一致：(a) 真的接上——CompanionApp 在把事件變成 behaviorIntent 前先用 director.score() 過濾（把 recentSameClass、alreadyResponded、doNotDisturb=gate.quiet、relevance/novelty 餵進去，<=0 就不反應），machine.ts 的平手判定也改用真實 ctx；或 (b) 刪掉 director.score()，並在 docs/CHANGELOG 誠實說明 Utility Scoring 目前只用於 machine 的同優先平手，Director 的節流靠 hazard＋冷卻＋防重複。
confirmed.regressionTest: Instrument scoreEvent with a call counter, run a scripted sequence of director.tick()/reactDetailed() calls across varied DirectorContext states (quiet, doNotDisturb, high recentInterruptions, repeated same-class events), and assert the counter stays 0 — proving Director's real decisions never invoke Utility Scoring.

confirmed.title: 活動紀錄的「重新驗證」是無回饋的 floating promise
confirmed.claim: `onClick={() => api.verifyAction(receipt.actionId)}` 沒有 await、沒有 catch、也沒有任何結果回報。驗證失敗時使用者看不到任何訊息（只有一個未處理的 promise rejection），成功時也沒有任何確認——這正是誠實階梯要求「結果未知不得靜默」的反面。同頁的「取消」按鈕（:117-128）就有 try/catch＋`setCancelMsg`，證明本頁已有正確樣板。
confirmed.evidence: ActivityPage.tsx:130-132 `{["acknowledged", "uncertain", "completed"].includes(receipt.currentStatus) && (<button onClick={() => api.verifyAction(receipt.actionId)}>重新驗證</button>)}`；對照 ActivityPage.tsx:116-128 的「取消」按鈕有 `try { await api.cancelAction(...); setCancelMsg("已要求取消。") } catch (e) { setCancelMsg(`取消失敗：${e}`) }`。

verdicts.reasoning: Read ActivityPage.tsx directly. Line 131 (verified current, unchanged from the finding's citation): `<button onClick={() => api.verifyAction(receipt.actionId)}>重新驗證</button>`. api.verifyAction (api.ts:287) returns `Promise<Receipt>` via Tauri `invoke`. The onClick handler discards this promise: no `await`, no `.then`, no `.catch`, no state write. Contrast with the adjacent 取消 (cancel) button at lines 116-129 in the same component, which does `try { await api.cancelAction(...); setCancelMsg("已要求取消。") } catch (e) { setCancelMsg(`取消失敗：${e}`) }` — proving the correct pattern is known and used one button away. Checked whether some ambient mechanism could substitute for feedback (e.g. periodic refreshKey polling elsewhere in App.tsx) — found `refreshKey` bumps do trigger action-list refetches elsewhere in the app, but that only eventually reflects a changed status if verification succeeds; it gives no signal on failure (rejected promise, network/backend error) and no explicit acknowledgment either way for this click, so it doesn't resolve the floating-promise problem. This is a genuine, reproducible violation of the repo's honesty-ladder invariant (verification result must not be silently swallowed) and matches the cited evidence exactly with no line drift.

confirmed.fix: 比照「取消」按鈕加 try/catch 與狀態訊息（成功也要說「已重新查驗，結果如下／仍不確定」，不得靜默）。
confirmed.regressionTest: Render ActivityStory for a receipt with currentStatus "acknowledged", mock api.verifyAction to reject, click 重新驗證, assert the UI shows an error/rejection message (or that the click handler is awaited/caught) rather than leaving an unhandled rejection and unchanged UI.

confirmed.title: 「現在」頁詳細狀態的工作階段開始／結束沒有失敗回報
confirmed.claim: 「開始工作階段」`await api.sessionStart("desktop", [])` 在 async onClick 裡沒有 try/catch，「結束工作階段」`api.sessionStop()` 是裸的 floating promise。任一失敗都不會出現在畫面上（同頁其他操作如暫停、停止感測都有 error state），使用者會以為狀態已改變。
confirmed.evidence: HomePage.tsx:312-323：`<button onClick={async () => { await api.sessionStart("desktop", []); onNavigate("home"); }}>開始工作階段</button>` 與 `<button onClick={() => api.sessionStop()}>結束工作階段</button>`；對照同檔 :63-72 的 `tryPause` 與 :76-92 的 `stopSensors` 都有錯誤路徑並寫進 `pauseError` / `sensorNotice`。

verdicts.reasoning: Read HomePage.tsx directly: lines 312-323 confirm the button block exactly as quoted in the finding — `await api.sessionStart("desktop", [])` sits inside an async onClick with no try/catch (line 315 is precisely `await api.sessionStart("desktop", []);`), and `結束工作階段` at line 322 calls `api.sessionStop()` as a bare, unawaited expression. Verified both `api.sessionStart`/`api.sessionStop` route through `call()` in transport.ts, which either calls Tauri's `invoke` (rejects on backend error) or, in HTTP mode, `http()` (transport.ts:58-87), which explicitly `throw new Error(...)` on any non-2xx response — so failures are real, throwing promises, not commands that silently no-op. Confirmed by contrast that the same file already has an established error-surfacing pattern for equivalent actions: `tryPause` (lines 63-72) wraps its await in try/catch and sets `pauseError`, and `stopSensors` (lines 76-92) wraps its await in try/catch and sets `sensorNotice`, both then rendered in the UI. No such state exists for session start/stop, and grep across apps/interaction-desktop/src confirms there is no global `window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", ...)` or `onerror` handler that would otherwise surface these rejections to the user. Console-only unhandled rejection is the only outcome; the UI gives no visible feedback, contradicting the file's own established convention and the project's error-visibility norms. Severity `low` is appropriate — it's a real inconsistency/regression risk (user believes the click succeeded), not a safety or data-integrity issue.

confirmed.fix: 兩顆按鈕都包 try/catch，失敗寫進既有的 `pauseError`（或新增 sessionError）並以 role="alert" 顯示。
confirmed.regressionTest: Mock api.sessionStart to reject (e.g. `jest.spyOn(api, "sessionStart").mockRejectedValue(new Error("network"))`), render HomePage in the no-session state, click "開始工作階段", and assert the component renders a visible error affordance (e.g. a `role="alert"`/error text) instead of only producing a console unhandled-rejection with no DOM change.

confirmed.title: 全域搜尋在一般模式印出知識更新的原始 triggeredBy 值
confirmed.file: apps/interaction-desktop/src/components/GlobalSearch.tsx:216（輔助證據中的 :157 應為 :196，pack.id 的顯示）
confirmed.claim: 知識收據項目的標籤在一般模式是 `知識更新：${String(receipt.triggeredBy)}`，直接顯示 runtime 的 kebab-case 原始值（`user-correction`／`review-overdue`／`conflict-detected`／`task-experience`／`human-review`）。HomePage 已有 `knowledgeTriggerLabel` 專門翻譯這個欄位並註明「認不得的值不外洩原始字串」，此處沒用。

"知識收據" : "知識更新"}：${String(receipt.triggeredBy)}``；helper 在 HomePage.tsx:387-401（`KNOWLEDGE_TRIGGER_LABEL` 與 `export function knowledgeTriggerLabel`），唯一呼叫點是 HomePage.tsx:367。同函式區塊 GlobalSearch.tsx:157 也把 `String(pack.id)` 當一般模式的 detail 直接顯示。

唯一與 finding 證據不符的細節：finding 提到「GlobalSearch.tsx:157 也把 String(pack.id) 當一般模式 detail 顯示」，但實際 pack.id 那行在目前檔案是 196 行（157 行目前是 provider 區塊的 rawState），屬於行號漂移，不影響主張本體（216 行的 triggeredBy 洩漏）成立。

confirmed.title: 一般模式的「關於我的記憶」暴露完整 10 層記憶 taxonomy，並預設把所有分層混列在同一個標題下

apps/interaction-desktop/src/pages/MemoryKnowledgePage.tsx:12-23 LAYER_LABEL 定義 10 層（含 `skill: "Skill"`、`"agent-handoff": "Agent 交接"`、`"character-memory": "角色經歷"`）。

<label className="field-label">分層
  <select value={layer} …>

verdicts.reasoning:
Read apps/interaction-desktop/src/pages/MemoryKnowledgePage.tsx in full and confirmed every element of the claim against current source (no drift):

1. LAYER_LABEL (lines 12-23) defines all 10 backend memory layers with technical labels ("Skill", "Agent 交接", "對話暫存", "領域 Know-how", "角色核心", "角色經歷", ...).

MemorySection's "分層" `<select>` (lines 125-136) is rendered unconditionally — there is no `{advanced && ...}` guard anywhere around it, and MemorySection itself is invoked identically for both advanced=false and advanced=true (line 78-80 in MemoryKnowledgePage, and the general-mode `simpleTabs` still routes to `active === "memory" → <MemorySection advanced={advanced} .../>`).

confirmed.title: wait_reply 靜默吞掉 broadcast lag，把「答覆可能被丟掉」講成「裝置沒回」
confirmed.claim: cmd／cancel／read／stop-all 四條請求路徑用的 wait_reply 對 RecvError::Lagged 直接 continue，完全不記錄丟了幾則；逾時訊息因此宣稱「no ack for action X」「device did not answer read」。但 WaitError 的文件（同檔 838-848）明寫 lagged>0 表示「答覆可能已經送到卻被丟了，呼叫端不該把它講成『裝置沒回』」，而握手路徑用的 wait_for 確實有做這件事。同一份收據 detail 會被人與 AI 讀成「裝置沒反應」，實際可能是 host 端 64 格 broadcast 追不上（裝置每 5 s 主動推 state、按鈕邊緣還會加推）。
confirmed.evidence: protocol.rs:547-557 `match tokio::time::timeout(remaining.min(RESET_POLL), rx.recv()).await { ... Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_))) => continue, ... }`；產生的訊息 protocol.rs:644-646 `"no ack for action {action_id} — outcome UNKNOWN (not retried: ...)"` 與 :726 `LinkError::Timeout("device did not answer read".into())`。對照 protocol.rs:889-921 wait_for_with 累加 lagged 並回 WaitError::TimedOut{lagged}，:853-857 Display 產生「timed out (N message(s) dropped while waiting; the reply may have been lost)」，:925-932 handshake_wait_error 把它寫進 detail。BROADCAST_CAP=64（serial.rs:24、mqtt.rs:19、ble.rs:23）。

verdicts.reasoning:
實地讀了 protocol.rs 全部相關段落，主張逐字成立：

1. wait_reply（526-558 行）是 command/cancel/read_state/stop_all 四條路徑共用的私有等待函式，553 行 `Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_))) => continue,` 直接丟棄 lag 數量，不計數、不回傳、不記 log。
2. 四條路徑產生的逾時訊息完全不提「可能是答覆被丟」：
   - command: 646 行 `"no ack for action {action_id} — outcome UNKNOWN (not retried: physical effects must not double-fire)"`
   - cancel: 680 行 `"no cancel ack for {action_id}"`
   - read_state: 726 行 `"device did not answer read"`
   - stop_all: 792 行 `"stop-all dispatched, no ack — device stop UNCONFIRMED"`
3. 對照握手路徑（ensure_ready，436/475 行）用的是模組級 `wait_for`/`wait_for_with`（877-921 行），LagPolicy::Tolerate 預設下會累加 `lagged` 並回 `WaitError::TimedOut{lagged}`；其 Display（853-857）明確附加「(N message(s) dropped while waiting; the reply may have been lost)」，並經 `handshake_wait_error`（925-931）寫進 LinkError::Timeout 的 detail——只有握手呼叫端拿到這個誠實提示。
4. `WaitError` 型別本身的文件（839-848 行）明講 `lagged > 0` 代表「答覆可能已經送到卻被丟了，呼叫端不該把它講成『裝置沒回』」——這正是 wait_reply 四條路徑違反的規範。
5. `BROADCAST_CAP = 64` 在 mqtt.rs:19、serial.rs:24、ble.rs:23 三個 transport 都確認存在，配合檔案本身註解「裝置每 5 s 主動推 state、按鈕邊緣還會加推」，broadcast lag 在真實使用下並非純理論風險。

這是同一支檔案內兩套等待機制的真實不一致：wait_reply 明明有能力偵測到 Lagged（catch 了這個 variant），卻選擇丟棄資訊而非像 wait_for_with 一樣累計並誠實揭露，直接牴觸專案「誠實階梯」不變量（不得把「答覆可能被丟」講成「裝置沒回」）。severity=low 合理，因為這只影響診斷訊息的精確度，不影響安全語意（仍誠實回 UNKNOWN/UNCONFIRMED，不會謊稱成功或自動重送），但診斷訊息誤導使用者/AI 去做錯誤的故障排除（懷疑裝置故障而非 host 端 broadcast buffer 太小）確實是真實可驗證的缺陷。</reasoning>
<parameter name="regression_test_sketch">用一個容量極小或人為灌爆的 broadcast channel，讓 command()/cancel()/read_state()/stop_all() 等待期間收到 RecvError::Lagged(n)，斷言最終回傳的 LinkError::Timeout detail 字串包含 lagged 訊息數量（例如比照 handshake_wait_error 的 "message(s) dropped while waiting" 措辭），而非目前的純 "no ack"/"did not answer"/"UNCONFIRMED"。</parameter>
</invoke>

confirmed.fix: 讓 wait_reply 也累加 lagged，並在 WaitEnd::TimedOut 帶出數量；命令／讀取的逾時文案在 lagged>0 時改成「等待期間有 N 則訊息被丟棄，答覆可能已到但遺失」，不要說 device did not answer。

confirmed.title: serial reader thread：drop(writer) 解不開 dup fd 上的 blocking read，pty／file fallback 每次重連洩漏一條 detach 的執行緒
confirmed.claim: reader 與 writer 是同一個 fd 的 try_clone（dup(2)）。POSIX 下關掉其中一個 dup 不會讓另一個 dup 上的 blocking read 返回，所以 `drop(writer); // 關掉 fd，讓 reader 的 blocking read 解除` 這個前提不成立。serialport 路徑有 200 ms 讀取逾時所以還好，但 ENOTTY file fallback（pty 模擬器與 CLI E2E 走的就是它）的 read 沒有逾時：裝置沉默時 reader 會一直卡著，500 ms 寬限後被 detach，每次重連／每次 shutdown 就留下一條永遠不會結束的執行緒。RawLink::shutdown 的契約寫的是「停止重連、回收執行緒／task」，實際回收不到。
confirmed.evidence: serial.rs:214-221 `PortHalves::File(file) => match file.try_clone() { Ok(r) => (Box::new(r), Box::new(file)), ... }`（std File::try_clone = dup，兩個 File 共用同一個 open file description，各自持有獨立 fd）；serial.rs:36-38 常數註解自己承認「pty fallback 的 read 沒有逾時，裝置完全沉默時可能還卡在 read」；serial.rs:289-307 `drop(writer); // 關掉 fd，讓 reader 的 blocking read 解除` 之後是 500 ms 輪詢 is_finished()，逾時就 `tracing::debug!(... "detaching it")`；serial.rs:204-206 的 RawLink trait 契約（protocol.rs:204-206）「主動關閉連線：停止重連、回收執行緒／task」。既有測試 pty_link_opens_and_shutdown_stops_the_supervisor 只斷言 supervisor 收工，沒有斷言 reader 執行緒被回收。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified by direct code reading plus an empirical repro.

Code trace (crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/serial.rs):
- `open_port` (line 76-98): serialport open fails with ENOTTY on a pty slave (macOS) → falls back to `std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(port)` — a plain blocking file open, no timeout, no O_NONBLOCK.
- `PortHalves::File(file) => file.try_clone()` (line 214-221): `reader` and `writer` are two independently-owned fds from `dup(2)` on the same open file description (the classic std::fs::File::try_clone semantics on Unix).
- `pump_lines` (334-377) does a plain `BufReader::read_line` on `reader` — for the file-fallback path this is a genuine indefinite blocking `read(2)`; the comment at 36-38 already concedes "pty fallback 的 read 沒有逾時".
- On shutdown/reconnect (line ~283-289): the writer loop exits, then `drop(writer); // 關掉 fd，讓 reader 的 blocking read 解除` — dropping `writer` closes only its own fd.
- Then a 500ms bounded poll on `handle.is_finished()`; if not finished, it logs debug and abandons the still-running thread (detach by omission — no `handle.join()`).

POSIX/Unix fact: two fds produced by `dup(2)` (exactly what `std::fs::File::try_clone` does) refer to the same open file description but are independent descriptor-table entries. `close(2)` on one dup does not affect, interrupt, or unblock a syscall pending on the other dup — the description stays alive as long as any fd still references it. This is standard, well-documented Unix behavior (distinct from e.g. `shutdown(2)` on a socket, which does propagate to peer fds).

I did not just cite the fact — I reproduced the exact scenario on this same platform (macOS 26.2, matching the file's own comment about where ENOTTY behavior was measured): opened a PTY slave, dup'd it into `reader_fd`/`writer_fd` (mirroring `file.try_clone()`), started a thread blocked in `os.read(reader_fd, ...)`, then closed `writer_fd` from the main thread (mirroring `drop(writer)`). Result: the reader thread stayed blocked (`thread alive = True`) for a full second after the close; it only returned once data was actually written from the pty master side. This falsifies the code's own comment, so the claim's premise is exactly right.

Consequence matches the claim: `reader_handle` is only joined opportunistically within the 500ms grace window; if the read hasn't unblocked by then (device/simulator silent, as the code's own comment on line 36-38 admits can happen), the thread is left running detached rather than reaped. Since a fresh `alive`/`reader_handle` is created on every reconnect iteration inside the `while !shutdown...` loop, each such stuck reconnect leaves one more orphaned blocked-in-read thread — this affects only the ENOTTY file-fallback path (pty simulator / CLI E2E), not the real serialport path, which is correctly mitigated by its 200ms read timeout (the finding itself makes this distinction, hence "low" severity).

I also checked the existing test `pty_link_opens_and_shutdown_stops_the_supervisor` (line ~757-808): it asserts `link.supervisor_finished()` within 2s, which is a different flag (`done`) set unconditionally at the end of `supervisor()` regardless of whether the reader thread joined — it does NOT assert the reader thread was reaped/joined. So the claim that the existing test doesn't cover reader-thread reclamation is also correct. (In that specific test, the reader thread does eventually get unblocked, but only because `pty.kill()` at test teardown kills the master-side python process, which triggers EOF/HUP on the slave read — not because of `drop(writer)`. That coincidental cleanup would not occur across intra-session reconnects with the simulator/master left running.)

No prior fix is present in the file as reviewed; line numbers and code content match the finding exactly (no drift).

confirmed.fix: file fallback 改用非阻塞 fd（O_NONBLOCK ＋ poll/select 帶逾時）或以 shutdown flag 可中斷的讀法；至少把「pty fallback 的 reader 可能被 detach 且不會回收」寫進 RawLink::shutdown 的契約與已知限制，並在 detach 時計數以便偵測洩漏。
confirmed.regressionTest: On the pty-fallback path, force two reconnect generations while the simulator stays silent and its master fd stays open, then after the second connect assert (e.g. via a named-thread probe for `serial-read-<port>`, or an instrumented completion counter in pump_lines) that only one reader thread from the current generation is alive — proving the prior generation's reader was actually reclaimed rather than merely detached.

confirmed.title: 非 gateway session 真的被 agent fetch 時不發 fetched taxonomy 事件，角色一直停在 queued
confirmed.claim: 規格 §7.4 要求 queued／fetched／working… 每一態都由真實事件驅動。`fetched` 目前只在 gateway 路徑（gateway.rs:714）發出；v0.3 輪詢流程的 agent 以 `MailboxReader::Agent` 呼叫 `mailbox_fetch` 真的取走任務、蓋了 `delivered_at`、也推進了委派 receipt，卻不發 `agent.session.state = fetched`。角色與 UI 因此停在 created/queued（「準備中」），直到 agent 自己回報 task-started 才跳到 working——fetched 這一態對非 gateway agent 等於不存在。
confirmed.evidence: agents.rs:706-757 `mailbox_fetch`：`m.delivered_at = Some(now); newly_delivered = true; ... acked.push(...)`，整段沒有任何 `emit_agent_session_state` 呼叫；唯一的 fetched 發射點是 gateway.rs:714 `self.emit_agent_session_state(session_id, &entry.record.agent_id, "fetched")`（`grep -rn emit_agent_session_state crates/` 只有 created/fetched/verified/taxonomy/timed-out/cancelled|closed/unknown 七個站點）。character.rs:387 的投影表已經備好 `"fetched" => (I::Think, T::Working)`，只是沒有事件餵它。

verdicts.reasoning: Read crates/interaction-runtime/src/agents.rs:707-758 (mailbox_fetch): for a non-gateway agent_id (observer_only=false via crate::gateway::agent_kind_for returning None), a real Agent-side fetch stamps delivered_at, sets newly_delivered=true, and forwards to acknowledge_delegated_action (which emits ActionAcknowledged) — but nowhere in this function is emit_agent_session_state called. `grep -rn emit_agent_session_state crates/` shows the only 'fetched' call site is gateway.rs:714, exclusive to the gateway (codex/claude-code) delivery path. Confirmed this is a live, reachable path: crates/interaction-api/src/routes.rs:1420-1429 maps AuthPrincipal::LegacyAgent/AgentSession to MailboxReader::Agent -> mailbox_fetch for GET /v1/agent-sessions/{id}/messages, and the CLI (main.rs:428) documents this exact fetch as the one that "marks delivery" for a non-gateway agent identity. Wrote and ran a minimal regression probe (crates/interaction-runtime/tests/zz_verify_fetched_gap.rs, removed after running, per the no-modify instruction): created a session with agent_id "agent.probe" (non-gateway), sent a task message, called rt.mailbox_fetch (the real MailboxReader::Agent path) which returned delivered_at=Some(...), then inspected AgentSessionState taxonomy events for that session — result was exactly ["created"], no "fetched" ever emitted. `cargo test -p interaction-runtime` ran this and the assertion failed exactly as predicted, proving the gap live. Also checked the existing regression test "agent_session_state_taxonomy_is_emitted_for_every_rung_of_the_ladder" (agents_loop.rs:668) which purports to cover every rung of the ladder but never exercises mailbox_fetch at all — its session A goes straight from "created" to "working" via report_agent_session("task-started"), silently skipping the fetched rung, so no existing test guards this path. character.rs:387 confirms "fetched" is a real entry in session_projection consumed by the Character Protocol, and emit_agent_session_state (agents.rs:788-796) is also the sole place that calls character_project_session, so both the taxonomy event and the character-presentation projection are skipped together for this path. Spec docs/specs/adaptive-interaction-v05-core-experience-prompt.md lines 93 ("小樞依真實事件呈現 queued／fetched／working…") and 368 ("Mailbox 真實 fetched／working 狀態") require this exact state to be event-driven. CHANGELOG.md only documents fetched-timing fixes for the gateway (codex/claude) path (lines 138/341/515/518), not this non-gateway gap, so it is not an already-known/documented limitation. This is a genuine, currently-reproducible defect, not a stale/already-fixed claim.

confirmed.fix: 在 `mailbox_fetch` 的 `newly_delivered` 分支（人類 peek 不算）補發 `fetched`，與 gateway 路徑一致。

confirmed.title: README 指令參數段寫 servo.move angle 0..180，與硬限制表及兩端實作的 10..170 矛盾

confirmed.title: StageRenderer.pause() 的契約說「不再回報互動框」，但 500ms pump 無條件 reportHitRect(true)，隱藏／suspend 後仍持續 IPC
confirmed.claim: pause() 的 doc comment 宣稱「取消 rAF、物理與粒子都停下，也不再回報互動框」，但 reportHitRect() 本身沒有任何 paused 判斷，而 CompanionApp 的 500ms pump 每一拍都以 force=true 呼叫它。因此角色被隱藏／CPP suspend 之後，WebView 仍每 500ms（頁面隱藏時瀏覽器節流後 ≥1s）發一次 Tauri IPC `companion_hit_rect`，並在 Rust 端取窗、上鎖、重評點擊穿透。這與「隱藏後計時器真的停」的預期不符，也讓 pause() 的契約敘述不成立。
confirmed.evidence: stage.ts:417-419 註解「暫停主迴圈（CPP §7 hide／suspend）：取消 rAF、物理與粒子都停下，**也不再回報互動框**」；stage.ts:525-534 `reportHitRect(force = false)` 只檢查 `this.hitRectCb` 與節流政策，沒有 `if (this.paused) return;`。CompanionApp.tsx:1344-1346 在 500ms pump 內 `const stage = stageRef.current; // 心跳：rAF 被系統節流／視窗隱藏時，至少每 500ms 還有一次互動框回報。 stage?.reportHitRect(true);`，且該 pump 的 cleanup 只在 effect 卸載時執行（CompanionApp.tsx:1417-1419），不隨 suspend 停止。落地端 src-tauri/src/lib.rs:2335-2366 `companion_hit_rect` 會取窗、clamp、上鎖寫入並呼叫 apply_companion_clickthrough（後者於 lib.rs:2236-2238 才因 `!win.is_visible()` 提早返回，所以 IPC 與鎖仍每拍發生）。

verdicts.reasoning: 逐行核對三個檔案，證據與現狀完全吻合，行號零漂移：(1) stage.ts:414-424 `pause()` 的 doc comment（418-419 行）明確宣稱「取消 rAF、物理與粒子都停下，也不再回報互動框」；但 reportHitRect(force=false)（stage.ts:525-534）的節流判斷是 `if (!force && !hitRectReportPolicy(...)) return;`——完全沒有 `if (this.paused) return;` 之類的守衛，`force=true` 時該行必然短路為 false，回呼一定會發生。(2) CompanionApp.tsx:1309-1422 的 500ms `pump`（setInterval）在第 1346 行對 `stageRef.current` 無條件呼叫 `reportHitRect(true)`，且此呼叫發生在函式最前段、任何 `gate.tick`／base-state 早退（如 emergency/offline/paused 判斷）之前。該 effect 的 cleanup（1416-1421 行）只在依賴陣列 `[ready, apply, syncPose, handlePresentationCommand]` 變動或卸載時執行，與角色的 hide／suspend／visible 狀態無關——搜尋全檔案找不到任何地方在 hide/suspend 時清掉或跳過這個 pump。(3) shu.ts 的 `hide()`（261-266）與 `suspend()`（268-271）都呼叫 `this.stage?.pause()`，`hide()` 的註解甚至寫「看不見就不畫、不算物理、不回報互動框」，但 `this.stage` 正是透過 `stageRenderer()` 回傳並存進 `CompanionApp` 的 `stageRef.current` 的同一個 StageRenderer 實例，所以 pause() 只取消了 rAF，擋不住外部 pump 的強制呼叫。(4) 落地端 `companion_hit_rect`（lib.rs:2335-2364）在呼叫 `apply_companion_clickthrough` 之前，一定會先做 `get_webview_window`、`clamp_hit_rect`、對 `state.companion_hit_rect` 上鎖寫入；`apply_companion_clickthrough`（2236-2238）只在其「內部」因 `!win.is_visible()` 提早返回，這只省掉游標/click-through 的計算，並不影響前面已完成的窗口查找與鎖寫入，也絲毫不影響 WebView 端已經發出的這次 IPC。整條鏈路（pause()／hide() 的 doc 宣稱 → 缺 paused 守衛的 reportHitRect → 不受 suspend 影響的 500ms pump → 每拍都執行部分工作的 Rust 端）在目前程式碼中確實成立，隱藏／suspend 後 IPC heartbeat 並未真正停止，與 pause() 的契約敘述矛盾。這不違反本專案任何「不可違反的不變量」（無實體副作用誤觸發、無 consent/estop 濫用、非感測靜默問題），屬於文件敘述與效能/資源浪費層級的落差，維持原判 low。

confirmed.title: SSE 把 agent.session.state 事件送給 agent token，違反 sse.rs 自己宣告的「SSE 必須與 REST 同界線」
confirmed.file: crates/interaction-api/src/lib.rs:436-449 (GET branch of agent_request_allowed, was cited 432-445); crates/interaction-api/src/lib.rs:465-467 (interrupt allow-list, was cited 458-460); crates/interaction-runtime/src/agents.rs:788-791 (emit_agent_session_state, was cited 789-792) — minor line drift only, content matches exactly; crates/interaction-api/src/sse.rs:22 matches exactly as cited
confirmed.claim: `agent_request_allowed` 明確禁止 agent token GET 任何 `/v1/agent-sessions*`，但 `event_allowed` 的排除清單漏了 `EventType::AgentSessionState`，所以 legacy agent token 只要開 `GET /v1/events` 就能持續收到所有 agent session 的 `{agentSessionId, agentId, state}`。這正是該函式註解說要避免的「SSE 變成被 REST 拒絕的 payload 的側通道」。搭配同檔允許的 `POST /v1/agent-sessions/{id}/interrupt`（`agent_request_allowed` 對任何 id 都放行，無擁有權檢查），agent 平面可以枚舉並中斷不屬於自己的 session。
confirmed.evidence: sse.rs:22-48 `event_allowed` 的 `!matches!(...)` 清單列了 KnowledgeUpdated／ConsentChanged／PolicyChanged／Sensor*／Presentation*／AiAssist*／Character*，但沒有 `AgentSessionState`；同檔 25-27 註解：「The legacy Agent token has no knowledge/memory/presentation/sensor authority. SSE must obey the same boundary as REST instead of becoming a side channel for payloads rejected by those route families.」。api/src/lib.rs:432-445 `agent_request_allowed` 的 GET 分支含 `&& !path.starts_with("/v1/agent-sessions")`；同檔 458-460 `if path.starts_with("/v1/agent-sessions/") && path.ends_with("/interrupt") { return true; }` 沒有比對 session 擁有者。事件內容見 agents.rs:789-792 `self.events.emit(EventType::AgentSessionState, json!({"agentSessionId": id, "agentId": agent_id, "state": state}))`。

verdicts.reasoning:
Verified every link of the claimed chain directly in current source (HEAD 521c232, worktree clean except .codegraph/):

1. sse.rs:22-48 `event_allowed`: for any non-Human principal it returns `!matches!(event.event_type, KnowledgeUpdated|ConsentChanged|PolicyChanged|Sensor*|Presentation*|AiAssist*|Character*)`. `EventType::AgentSessionState` (interaction-core/src/event.rs:96-97, a distinct enum variant, `#[serde(rename="agent.session.state")]`) is NOT in that list, so it evaluates true — the event is delivered to LegacyAgent (and any other non-Human) principal. The comment directly above (sse.rs:26-28) explicitly states SSE "must obey the same boundary as REST instead of becoming a side channel for payloads rejected by those route families" — a self-documented invariant this omission violates.

2. `agent_request_allowed`'s GET branch (lib.rs:436-449) explicitly excludes `/v1/agent-sessions` for the legacy Agent token (`&& !path.starts_with("/v1/agent-sessions")`, line 440) — confirming GET /v1/agent-sessions* is REST-rejected for LegacyAgent.

3. `/v1/events` (sse::events) is registered in the same `authed` router under the same `auth_middleware` (lib.rs:290) and is not excluded by any prefix in the GET branch, so `GET /v1/events` IS allowed for LegacyAgent — reachable by the very token REST-blocks from agent-sessions.

4. `emit_agent_session_state` (interaction-runtime/src/agents.rs:787-791) emits `{agentSessionId, agentId, state}` for every agent-session state transition system-wide, unscoped to any requester.

5. `agent_request_allowed`'s POST branch (lib.rs:465-467): `if path.starts_with("/v1/agent-sessions/") && path.ends_with("/interrupt") { return true; }` — allowed for ANY session id, no ownership comparison.

6. `agent_session_interrupt` handler (routes.rs:1852-1856) calls `runtime.gateway_interrupt(&id)` with no ownership/auth-context check in the handler.

7. `gateway_interrupt` (interaction-runtime/src/gateway.rs:911-926) only checks the session exists (`self.gateway.managed(session_id)`) — no comparison against caller identity anywhere.

8. Confirmed shared id-namespace: gateway.rs:714 calls `self.emit_agent_session_state(session_id, &entry.record.agent_id, "fetched")` using the exact same `session_id` that keys `gateway.managed()` — an id learned from an SSE `AgentSessionState` event is directly usable against the interrupt endpoint.

By contrast, the newer per-session `AgentSession(capability)` principal correctly scopes both: `session_request_allowed` restricts interrupt to `id == capability.session_id`, and that principal's allow-list never includes `/v1/events` at all — proving the codebase already implements, and enforces, an ownership concept for this exact resource; only the coarser legacy-token path was left unscoped, i.e. an inconsistency between two access-control mechanisms for the same resource, not a fabricated concern.

Searched docs/reviews/adversarial/*.json (all prior run JSONs) and CHANGELOG.md / docs/acceptance-evidence.md for prior mention of "event_allowed" + "AgentSessionState" or an agent-sessions-interrupt ownership gap — found none; this is not a previously-known/accepted limitation. The crate's own `auth_scope_tests` module (lib.rs, end of file) exercises adapter-token denials and a couple of agent-token denials, but never exercises `event_allowed`, GET `/v1/events` for LegacyAgent, or interrupt ownership for LegacyAgent — so the gap is not covered by existing tests either.

Severity kept at "low" as reported: impact is confined to the AI/agent trust plane (a legacy-token holder — already able to call `/v1/tools/*/call`, emergency-stop, stop-all, etc. — additionally gains read visibility into all agent sessions' state/agent-id and can send an interrupt to any agent subprocess it does not own), is local-only (127.0.0.1, bearer-token gated), and "interrupt" is a soft signal rather than data exfiltration or an unrecoverable safety action; it doesn't touch human-only data (memory/knowledge/presentation/character stay correctly excluded) or consent/estop/policy authority. But it is a real, reproducible breach of a boundary the code itself declares, and does let one agent-plane token holder discover and interrupt agent sessions it does not own.

confirmed.fix: 把 `EventType::AgentSessionState` 加進 `event_allowed` 的排除清單（或改成白名單制），並在 sse.rs 既有的 `legacy_agent_sse_cannot_read_...` 測試加上這個 case；順帶考慮讓 `/v1/agent-sessions/{id}/interrupt` 對 AgentSession principal 之外的 agent token 也做擁有權比對。
confirmed.regressionTest: Unit test asserting `event_allowed(&AuthContext{principal: AuthPrincipal::LegacyAgent}, &RuntimeEvent{event_type: EventType::AgentSessionState, ...}) == false`, paired with an `agent_request_allowed` change that scopes `POST /v1/agent-sessions/{id}/interrupt` to sessions the legacy token is entitled to (or removes blanket allow), asserting a cross-session interrupt attempt is now refused.

confirmed.title: 撤銷已連線手機時，連線收尾的 was_active 永遠是 false：不發 sensor.stopped、不收斂 stop 等待者、不結掉在途 act
confirmed.claim: `mobile_revoke` 在取消 CancellationToken 之前就先把 `conns` 表項移除，因此 handler 收尾時 `conns.get(&device_id)` 一定是 `None`，`was_active` 恆為 false。結果是撤銷路徑跳過了斷線路徑做的三件事：(a) 該手機的麥克風正在串流時不補發 `sensor.stopped` 事件（只有 4 秒輪詢的 status 會讓指示燈熄滅，事件面與 status 不一致）；(b) 不呼叫 `stop_sensors.mark_disconnected()`，並行中的停止等待會等滿逾時後回報 `unknown` 而不是 `unreachable`；(c) 不呼叫 `fail_pending_for_device`，送給該手機的在途 act 要等滿 4 秒 ACT_TIMEOUT 才收斂，`status.pendingActs` 期間仍 >0。
confirmed.evidence: mobile.rs:2153-2157（`mobile_revoke`）：`let conn = self.mobile.conns.write().await.remove(device_id); let was_connected = conn.is_some(); if let Some(conn) = conn { conn.close.cancel(); }`。mobile.rs:3150-3161（收尾）：`let (was_active, was_streaming) = { let mut conns = self.mobile.conns.write().await; match conns.get(&device_id) { Some(c) if c.conn_id == conn_id => { … (true, streaming) } _ => (false, false) } };`，其後 `if was_active { stop_sensors.mark_disconnected(); let ended = self.mobile.fail_pending_for_device(&device_id); … if was_streaming { self.events.emit(EventType::SensorStopped, …) } }`。現有測試 `revoke_disconnects_live_connection_immediately`（tests/mobile_loop.rs:773-836）沒有覆蓋「撤銷時麥克風正在串流」或「撤銷時有在途 act」。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自逐行核對，主張成立且行號精確吻合現行檔案。

1) `mobile_revoke`（crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs:2153-2157）：`let conn = self.mobile.conns.write().await.remove(device_id);` 在 `conn.close.cancel()` **之前**就把 conns 表項移除。

2) handler 收尾（同檔 3150-3161）：`close.cancelled()` 分支 break 出迴圈後落到共用收尾區塊，`match conns.get(&device_id) { Some(c) if c.conn_id == conn_id => (true, streaming), _ => (false, false) }`——因為 conns 表項在步驟(1)已被移除，這裡永遠命中 `_` 分支，`was_active` 對撤銷路徑是**確定性**恆為 false（不是機率性 race），三件事全部被跳過：
   - (b) `stop_sensors.mark_disconnected()`（3166）不被呼叫：`wait_for_stop_confirmation`（1381-1403）在沒有 `disconnected=true` 時只能等到 `deadline` 逾時才回 `Unknown`，而非立即被喚醒回 `Unreachable`——若撤銷當下剛好有 `stop_sensors_for` 在等這台手機確認，會多等到完整 timeout。此為真實可重現的競態視窗。
   - (c) `fail_pending_for_device`（3167）不被呼叫：`act()`（1114-1119）用 `ACT_TIMEOUT`（55 行，4 秒）等 ack；`pending_len()`（1040-1042）直接回傳 `pending_acts` map 長度，不論裝置是否仍連線。撤銷當下若有送往該手機的在途 act，`status.pendingActs` 會維持 >0 直到滿 4 秒逾時才收斂——證據確鑿。
   - (a) `EventType::SensorStopped`（3177-3184）不被 emit：確認屬實，且我進一步查證 `mobile_disable_high_risk_receptors`（mobile_revoke 內同步呼叫，不受 was_active 閘門）呼叫 `registry.set_receptor_enabled(false)`，這會 emit **不同**事件 `EventType::ReceptorOffline`（interaction-registry/src/providers.rs 附近 set_receptor_enabled 實作，104-119 行）。同時 `mobile_revoke` 也會呼叫 `providers.transition(..Revoked..)`，emit `EventType::ProviderStateChanged`（interaction-registry/src/providers.rs:69-72）。桌面端 `host_safety_relevant`（apps/interaction-desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:2652-2663）把 `ProviderStateChanged` 也列入「立刻刷新 tray／overlay，不等 4 秒輪詢」的事件集合——**這部分修正了 evidence 裡「只有 4 秒輪詢的 status 會讓指示燈熄滅」的說法**：撤銷當下 tray／overlay 實際上會經由 ProviderStateChanged 立即刷新，不必等 4 秒輪詢。但 `apps/interaction-desktop/src/statusProjection.ts`（231-404 行）顯示前端另有一條「安全事件收件匣」歷史，明確以 `sensor.stopped` 這個具體事件類型記錄「感測結束」條目——`ProviderStateChanged`／`ReceptorOffline` 不會被投影成這則歷史紀錄，因此撤銷一台正在串流麥克風的手機，該次串流「結束」永遠不會出現在事件歷史／收件匣裡，這是真實、可驗證的事件面缺口（不是純粹重複於既有防護）。

3) 測試覆蓋確認：`tests/mobile_loop.rs` 內所有 `mobile_revoke` 呼叫點（758/779/1188/1682/1708 行）逐一核對，沒有任一測試在呼叫 `mobile_revoke` 前先讓麥克風進入串流狀態（`mic_since` 有值）或先送出未 ack 的 act，`revoke_disconnects_live_connection_immediately`（773-836 行）也只驗證斷線與觀察被拒，未驗證串流/在途 act 情境——test-coverage 缺口屬實。

結論：核心程式碼行為（was_active 恆假、三件事被跳過）100% 確認；evidence 中「tray 指示燈需等 4 秒輪詢」這一句對桌面 overlay 而言不準確（ProviderStateChanged 已提供即時刷新路徑），但這只是描述某個下游影響的措辭略誇大，不影響「revoke 路徑跳過 mark_disconnected／fail_pending_for_device／SensorStopped emit」這個根本、可重現的缺陷本身，且對「感測事件歷史」與「pendingActs 延遲收斂」兩點的具體影響仍然真實存在。維持 low 嚴重度：屬於使用者主動撤銷這條相對少見的操作路徑，影響視窗有界（≤4 秒）、且高風險受器本身在 mobile_revoke 內已同步強制 disabled（安全屬性沒有被破壞，只是事件面/收斂時間不一致）。

confirmed.fix: `mobile_revoke` 不要自己移除 conns 表項，改成只 `close.cancel()`（讓 handler 走同一條收尾邏輯），或在 revoke 內直接呼叫 `mark_disconnected()`／`fail_pending_for_device()`／補發 `sensor.stopped`。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在 `tests/mobile_loop.rs` 新增測試：pair 一台手機、送一則 `observation` 讓 `iphone.mic-level` 進入 mic_since（或直接送 `status` 帶 `sensors.micLevel:true`）使其被視為 streaming，同時對該裝置 `dispatch` 一個尚未 ack 的 act 使 pending_acts 非空，接著呼叫 `rt.mobile_revoke(&device_id)`；斷言（1）短時間內 events 流出現 `EventType::SensorStopped`（reason=disconnected/revoked），（2）`rt.mobile_status()["pendingActs"]` 幾乎立即變 0（不必等 4 秒 ACT_TIMEOUT），（3）該 act 的呼叫端立即收到 err/disconnected 而非等滿 timeout。

confirmed.title: iphone.motion 的 at 事實永遠到不了 runtime：iOS 送在訊息頂層，Rust 只過濾 facts
confirmed.claim: `iphone.motion` 的 manifest 宣告 `provides: ["event", "at"]`，`filter_mobile_facts` 也把 `at` 列入 facts 白名單，但 iOS App 把 ISO8601 時間戳放在 observation 訊息的**頂層**欄位而不是 `facts` 裡，Rust 只讀 `v["facts"]`。因此真機／模擬器送來的 motion 觀察永遠只有 `event` 一個事實，`at` 這個白名單分支是死碼，而能力 manifest（也是 UI「可以提供」卡與 HumanMeta `fact_fields` 的來源）對外宣稱了一個實際上永遠不會出現的欄位，語意事件自己的時間戳也被丟掉（只剩伺服器的 received_at）。
confirmed.evidence: mobile.rs:125-134 `MobileReceptorSpec { id: "iphone.motion", … provides: &["event", "at"], … }`；mobile.rs:209-222 `filter_mobile_facts` 只對 `facts.as_object()` 過濾；mobile.rs:3070 呼叫端 `filter_mobile_facts(receptor, &v["facts"])`。iOS 端 Protocol.swift:315-323：`case .observation(let receptor, let facts, let at): var object = ["type":…, "receptor":…, "facts": .object(facts)]; if let at { object["at"] = .string(at) }`（`at` 在頂層，不在 facts）；SensorCenter.swift:166-170 `.observation(receptor: "iphone.motion", facts: ["event": .string(kind.rawValue)], at: WireTime.nowISO8601())`；iOS 測試 ProtocolTests.swift:60 `XCTAssertEqual(motionObject["at"] as? String, "2026-08-28T10:00:00.000Z")` 把頂層形狀釘死。Rust 測試 tests/mobile_loop.rs:343-353 只用手寫的 `{"event":…}` facts，沒有比對真實 wire 形狀。

verdicts.reasoning: 逐項核對原始碼與 iOS 端，主張完全成立。(1) crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs:128 `iphone.motion` 的 MobileReceptorSpec 宣告 `provides: &["event", "at"]`。(2) mobile.rs:209-222 `filter_mobile_facts` 只對傳入的 `facts: &Value` 做 `.as_object()` 過濾，不知道也不處理任何頂層欄位。(3) 唯一呼叫點在 mobile.rs:3078 `filter_mobile_facts(receptor, &v["facts"])`——只把 `facts` 子物件傳進去；之後把過濾出的 facts 直接送進 `self.ingest(receptor, facts, BTreeMap::new(), 1.0)`；全檔（含 runtime.rs 的 ingest/ingest_with_gate）搜尋 `v["at"]`／`v.get("at")` 完全沒有命中——`grep -n '"at"' crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs` 只有第 128 行的 provides 宣告本身。(4) iOS 端 Protocol.swift:314-323 `case .observation(let receptor, let facts, let at)` 把 `at` 放進訊息物件的**頂層**鍵（`object["at"] = .string(at)`），不在 `facts` 裡；SensorCenter.swift:167-170 `emitMotionEvent` 呼叫 `.observation(receptor: "iphone.motion", facts: ["event": ...], at: WireTime.nowISO8601())`，證實 motion 事件確實會帶非 nil 的 `at`（對照同檔 `sendBatteryObservation` 明確傳 `at: nil`，顯示 `at` 欄位是刻意只給 motion 用、且刻意放在頂層）。(5) ProtocolTests.swift:60 `XCTAssertEqual(motionObject["at"] as? String, ...)` 把這個「頂層 at」的線協定形狀釘死成契約，不是巧合或臨時形狀。(6) Rust 測試 tests/mobile_loop.rs 中所有 `iphone.motion` 相關案例（644、810、979、1017 等）的 JSON 都只有 `{"event":...}`，第 340-352 行的 `filter_mobile_facts_keeps_only_manifest_provides` 也只直接呼叫函式本身、傳入手造的 facts 物件，從未建構「頂層帶 at」的完整 wire 訊息並斷言它被保留——即 Rust 測試套件從未覆蓋這條路徑；親自跑 `cargo test -p interaction-runtime --test mobile_loop filter_mobile_facts_keeps_only_manifest_provides` 通過，但只證明函式本身行為符合白名單邏輯，完全沒有觸及「頂層 at 讀不到」這個缺陷。(7) manifest 對外可見性也查證屬實：mobile.rs:2004 `fact_fields: spec.provides.iter()...` 把 `["event","at"]` 原樣寫進對外能力描述（apps/interaction-desktop/src/api.ts:595 `factFields?: string[]` 是前端對應型別），所以 UI「可以提供」卡與 HumanMeta 確實會宣稱一個永遠不會出現的 `at` 欄位。結論：`at` 白名單分支是死碼，iOS 送出的語意事件時間戳確實被丟棄，manifest 對外宣稱與實際行為不一致——嚴重度 low（不涉及安全不變量、不造成假 verified／假成功，只是 telemetry 精度與 manifest 誠實性的落差），與原報告一致；行號未實質漂移（128、209-222、3078，原報告寫 3070 屬同一小段內的鄰近行）。

confirmed.fix: 擇一：(a) Rust 端在過濾前把頂層 `at` 併進 facts（受白名單約束）；或 (b) 把 `at` 從 `provides` 拿掉並在協定文件說明時間戳是訊息層欄位。同時補一個以 iOS ProtocolTests 的實際 JSON 為輸入的 Rust 回歸測試，避免兩端形狀再次漂移。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在 tests/mobile_loop.rs 建構一則完整 wire 訊息 json!({"type":"observation","receptor":"iphone.motion","facts":{"event":"lifted"},"at":"2026-08-28T10:00:00.000Z"})，跑過連線處理流程後斷言產生的 Observation 帶有等於該 at 值的時間戳（而不是伺服器 received_at）——目前程式碼下此斷言會失敗，證明缺陷成立。

confirmed.title: 失敗的 auth（未知裝置／錯 token／已撤銷）完全沒有 audit
confirmed.claim: `auth` 驗證失敗時只送 `auth-fail` 並關閉連線，沒有寫任何 audit。相對地，配對失敗（`mobile.pair-failed`／`mobile.pair-burned-by-peer`）、未認證逾時（`mobile.unauthenticated-timeout`）、入站速率超限（`mobile.rate-limited`）都有 audit。結果是「已撤銷的手機持續嘗試重連」或「區網上有人拿猜測的 deviceId/token 試」在 audit 與 status 上完全無跡可循——撤銷後的效果無法被使用者驗證，也沒有偵測面。
confirmed.evidence: mobile.rs:3014-3027：`Some("auth") if authed.is_none() => { … let ok = { … d.token_hash == sha256_hex(token.as_bytes()) … }; if !ok { send(&out_tx, json!({"type":"auth-fail","reason":"unknown device or bad token (possibly revoked)"})).await; break; }`——`if !ok` 分支只有 send + break，沒有 `self.store.audit(...)`。對照 mobile.rs:2867-2878（`mobile.unauthenticated-timeout`）、2905-2920（`mobile.rate-limited`）、2944-2958（`mobile.pair-failed`／`mobile.pair-burned-by-peer`）。`mobile_status` 的 heartbeat 區塊也只有 `refusedConnections`，沒有 failedAuth 計數。

verdicts.reasoning:
驗證屬實。crates/interaction-runtime/src/mobile.rs 的 `mobile_handle_conn`（同一函式，全 repo 僅此一處）在 `Some("auth") if authed.is_none()` 分支（現行行號 3014-3027）中，token/deviceId 驗證失敗（`if !ok`，3024-3027）只有 `send(&out_tx, json!({"type":"auth-fail",...}))` 加 `break`，沒有任何 `self.store.audit(...)` 呼叫。

對照同一函式內其餘失敗路徑均有 audit：
- `mobile.unauthenticated-timeout`（2789-2801）
- `mobile.rate-limited`（2843-2851，且此為全連線流量限速，不是逐次認證失敗計數——用短連線各試一次的攻擊者不會觸發它）
- `mobile.pair-failed` / `mobile.pair-burned-by-peer`（約 2944-2958，實測 2945/2952）
- 甚至撤銷後重連的 auth-fail（2778，`reason:"revoked"`，屬 `close.cancelled()` 分支）在 `mobile_revoke` 端已有 audit（2123 附近文件標明撤銷本身會 audit），但「未知裝置／錯 token」這條路徑完全沒有對應的失敗事件記錄。

`mobile_status`（2098-2119）的 heartbeat 只暴露 `refusedConnections`（連線數上限）與 `droppedObservations`，沒有任何 failedAuth／badToken 計數欄位，也印證「這件事在 status 上無跡可循」的主張。

全 repo grep（含 tests/mobile_loop.rs、examples/fake_iphone.rs、iOS 端）確認沒有任何測試斷言此路徑會寫 audit——mobile_loop.rs:2892 只驗證回傳 `auth-fail` 訊息本身，不驗證 audit side effect，所以現狀不是「已被測試覆蓋的防護」而是真的空缺。

嚴重度評為 low 合理：不影響安全強制本身（token 仍正確拒絕），純粹是可觀測性／稽核缺口——已撤銷手機持續嘗試重連、或區網內猜測 deviceId/token 的行為完全不會出現在 audit log 或 status 中，使用者無法驗證撤銷生效、也無偵測面，這確實牴觸專案「感測不靜默」「效果需可驗證」的精神，但不是治理繞過或誠實階梯的直接違反。

confirmed.fix: 在 `if !ok` 分支加 `mobile.auth-failed` audit（peer 位址、送來的 deviceId、是否為已撤銷的 id），並在 `mobile_status().heartbeat` 加一個 `failedAuths` 計數，讓「撤銷後仍有人重連」看得見。
confirmed.regressionTest: 在 mobile_loop.rs 新增測試：配對後送 `{"type":"auth","deviceId":<known-or-unknown-id>,"token":"wrong"}`，斷言收到 `auth-fail` 後，透過測試專用的 audit 查詢介面（或 store 的記憶體 log）能找到一筆 event 類型如 `mobile.auth-failed` 且帶 deviceId/peer 資訊；目前該斷言會失敗，因為根本沒有寫入。

refuted.title: sprite adapter 的 presentationHints.variant 是開放詞彙：AI 可讓角色假演緊急停止／被擋下／離線／結果未知，並用 variant="paused" 強制清掉真正的安全訊息
refuted.claim: resolveSpriteAnimation 對「非安全 intent」允許用 presentationHints.variant 直接指名 pack 內任一動畫，只排除 "success"。由於 Rust 端 animation_projection() 刻意把 AI 請求的安全動畫名「降級 intent、但把原名保留成 variant」，AI 呼叫 companion.animation.play{animation:"emergency"} 會得到 intent=notice + variant="emergency"，sprite adapter 就選中 pack 的 emergency 動畫，經 MixerRenderer→machineEventForAnimation("emergency") 讓 machine 進入 base="emergency"。同理可得 offline（base）、blocked（安全 transient，priority 90、4.5 s、一般 cancel 清不掉）、unknown（5 s）、waiting（10 s）。最嚴重的是 variant="paused"→{type:"clear-transient", force:true}，正是 estop clear-all 專用的 force 路徑，會把真實的 blocked／failed／unknown 安全訊息從角色身上抹掉——machine.ts 自己的註解寫「安全訊息只能被 force（estop clear-all）清掉；AI 可達的 presentation cancel 不走這裡」。這違反「AI 不可解除 emergency stop」「角色呈現層沒有權限主權」與誠實階梯（演出未發生的安全狀態）。
refuted.evidence:
spriteIntents.ts:100 `if (!safety && opts.variant && animations[opts.variant] && opts.variant !== "success")` → `base = opts.variant`；sprite.ts:138-140 `resolveSpriteAnimation(this.pack.animations, intent, { truthState, variant: envelope.presentationHints?.variant })`，:152 `this.renderer?.setAnimation(resolved.animation, resolved.frameSlice)`。renderer 在生產路徑就是 MixerRenderer（CompanionApp.tsx:955 `new SpriteCharacterAdapter({ pack: legacy, assetBase, renderer: new MixerRenderer(real, mixer) })`），machine.ts:226-236 `case "emergency": return { type:"base", base:"emergency" }` / `case "idle": case "paused": return { type:"clear-transient", force:true }`。AI 端可達性：crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:454-467 `animation_projection`（`if intent.is_safety() { return (intent.ai_safe_substitute(), Some(name.to_string())) }`）＋:1725 `envelope.presentation_hints = Some(PresentationHints { variant, .. })`；desktop 收到後 CompanionApp.tsx:1235 `gateway.dispatch(envelope, "runtime")` 不再過濾 hints。實測（node 直接跑 resolveSpriteAnimation+machineEventForAnimation+reduce，pack=public/packs/shu-standard/manifest.json）：
ai notice + variant=emergency -> anim=emergency, event={"type":"base","base":"emergency"}, state={"base":"emergency"}
ai notice + variant=blocked  -> event={"type":"transient","kind":"blocked"}, untilMs=4500
ai notice + variant=unknown  -> kind="unknown", untilMs=5000
ai notice + variant=offline  -> base="offline"
ai notice + variant=paused   -> event={"type":"clear-transient","force":true}
ai notice + variant=success  -> 被擋（回退 notice）
可用性：public/characters/{shu-standard,shu-minimal,shu-lively,shu-agile,shu-lazy}/manifest.json entrypoint 皆為 {"kind":"builtin","id":"sprite"}，且 public/packs/*/manifest.json 的 animations 都含 emergency,offline,blocked,unknown,paused（shu-lively/agile/lazy 另含 failed）。

verdicts.reasoning:
The finding's central claim — that AI can call companion.animation.play with animation:"emergency"/"offline"/"blocked"/"unknown" and get the sprite adapter to actually perform those safety poses — is refuted by an existing, tested gate the finding never examined.

The real AI-reachable pipeline for `companion.animation.play` is: PresentationActuator::execute() (crates/interaction-runtime/src/presentation.rs:734-786) calls `validate_params(kind, &action, &playable)` at line 755-756 BEFORE ever reaching `character_ai_present`/`animation_projection` (only invoked at line 782, after validation succeeds). `validate_params` for PresentationKind::AnimationPlay (line 561-568) rejects with `ActuatorError::Rejected` any animation name not in `playable = self.bridge.playable_animations()`. `playable_animations_for` (presentation.rs:64-77) explicitly strips out `PLAYABLE_DENY_LIST` names (presentation.rs:46-58: "success", "blocked", "unknown", "failed", "emergency", "offline", "ask", "request-consent", …) and anything that parses to a canonical safety `CharacterIntent`. So `companion.animation.play{animation:"emergency"}` (and offline/blocked/unknown/failed) is rejected outright and never reaches `animation_projection` — the AI cannot get intent=notice+variant="emergency" (etc.) onto the wire at all.

This is independently confirmed by a passing, pre-existing regression test: `cargo test -p interaction-runtime playable_animations` → `playable_animations_follow_negotiation_and_deny_truth_states` (crates/interaction-runtime/tests/character_loop.rs:1166+) passes and explicitly asserts `!after.iter().any(|a| a == "emergency")` ("safety intent") and that `companion.animation.play{"animation":"success"}` is refused with `ActionStatus::Failed`.

The finding's own reproduction ("ai notice + variant=emergency -> anim=emergency…") was produced by hand-feeding `resolveSpriteAnimation` with fabricated intent/variant pairs directly, never demonstrating that the real Rust pipeline (`validate_params` → `playable_animations` → `animation_projection` → dispatch) can actually produce those envelopes. It cites `crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:454-467` (animation_projection) but never inspects `presentation.rs`'s `validate_params`/`PLAYABLE_DENY_LIST`, which sits directly upstream and blocks the claimed inputs.

One narrower, genuinely-reachable wrinkle exists but is NOT what the finding describes: "paused" is absent from PLAYABLE_DENY_LIST and is an alias of the non-safety `Sleep` intent (crates/interaction-character/src/capability.rs:326 `Sleep => &["sleep","paused"]`), so `companion.animation.play{animation:"paused"}` does pass the whitelist and produces intent=Sleep (not "notice" as claimed) + variant="paused", which via MixerRenderer→machineEventForAnimation("paused") does reach `{type:"clear-transient",force:true}` in machine.ts — and the always-playable canonical "idle" reaches the same force-clear branch even more directly. Whether this can actually erase an in-flight genuine safety pose depends on CPP-Gateway channel-ownership timing (AI envelopes carry priority 30, safety floors are 75-90, so `canPreempt` blocks immediate preemption; the AI request only dispatches once the underlying safety command's own short CPP-level lifecycle finishes, e.g. ~500ms for "blocked" vs. its 4500ms exposure in the visual machine per public/packs/shu-standard/manifest.json's frame/fps data) — a real but materially different, narrower, and unverified-in-practice mechanism than "AI can fake-perform emergency/blocked/offline/unknown and instantly wipe safety text" as the finding asserts. Since the finding's stated evidence and central claim (impersonating 5 specific safety states via companion.animation.play) is factually wrong and contradicted by a passing test, I mark it not confirmed.

逐段追完整條鏈路，全部在目前檔案內容中成立，行號與引用皆準確無漂移：

1. crates/interaction-character/src/intent.rs:120-127 `ai_safe_substitute`：Emergency/Offline/Blocked/Unknown/Cancelled 全部降級為 Notice（Wait→Think）。
2. crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:454-467 `animation_projection`：intent.is_safety() 為真時回傳 `(ai_safe_substitute(), Some(原始名稱))`；"paused" 經 intent_variant_aliases 命中 Sleep（非安全）一樣把原字串塞進 variant。
3. crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:1696-1699 `character_ai_present` 對 AnimationPlay 直接呼叫 animation_projection，並把 variant 原樣寫進 `envelope.presentation_hints`（:1725 附近）。
4. crates/interaction-character/src/intent.rs:505-524 `from_ai_request`：intent 降級後 `is_safety()==false` → `interrupt_policy = InterruptPolicy::Queue`（見 from_runtime :488-491）。
5. crates/interaction-character/src/gateway.rs 的 `dispatch`：channel 衝突邏輯只在 `InterruptPolicy::Preempt`／`DropIfBusy` 分支處理，`Queue` 落入 `_ => {}`——完全不擋，新 envelope 一律送出。這代表就連 Gateway 這層也未實作「安全 intent 才能搶占」的規則對 Queue-policy envelope 生效，與 docs/character-protocol/README.md 第 31 行不變量 #5「custom channel 不能影響安全搶占」直接矛盾。
6. apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/spriteIntents.ts:100（現況核對一致）：非安全 intent 時 `opts.variant` 可覆寫成 pack 內任一動畫（除 success）。
7. apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/adapters/sprite.ts:138-140,152（行號核對一致）：`perform()` 把 `envelope.presentationHints?.variant` 原樣傳給 resolveSpriteAnimation，且不論任何優先權，直接呼叫 `renderer.setAnimation`，取代目前 active 的呈現。
8. apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/mixerRenderer.ts 與 machine.ts:226-236（行號核對一致）：canonical 名稱 "emergency"/"offline" 產生 `{type:"base"}`、"idle"/"paused" 產生 `{type:"clear-transient", force:true}`——這兩種事件完全繞過 `transientCompetition` 的優先權梯（只有 `"transient"` 事件類型才走 competition），且 machine.ts 自己的註解明白宣稱這條路徑「只有 Runtime 或 Gateway 依 priority 擋掉」才會到——但第 5 點已證明 Gateway 對降級後的 Queue-policy envelope 並不會擋。
9. 生產接線：apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/CompanionApp.tsx:955 `new SpriteCharacterAdapter({..., renderer: new MixerRenderer(real, mixer)})`，非測試專用。
10. 可達性：public/characters/{shu-standard,shu-minimal,shu-lively,shu-agile,shu-lazy}/manifest.json entrypoint 皆為 sprite；public/packs/*/manifest.json 的 animations 確實含 emergency/offline/blocked/unknown/paused（lively/agile/lazy 另含 failed）——逐一以 python3 解析驗證屬實。

結論：AI 可經合法、policy 允許的 companion.animation.play 呼叫（intent 降級後屬 ai_allowed 範圍，truthState 強制 none），讓桌面小樞（生產角色，非測試 fixture）視覺上假演 emergency／offline／blocked／unknown，且 variant="paused" 會觸發 force:true 的 clear-transient，把正在顯示的真實安全 transient（blocked／failed／unknown）不當地清除——這正是 machine.ts 註解宣稱「只有 estop force-clear-all 才能做」的路徑。這直接違反 docs/character-protocol/README.md 明文的不變量 #1（呈現層沒有權限主權）與 #5（custom channel 不能影響安全搶占），也違反 CLAUDE.md「AI 不可解除 emergency stop」「角色呈現層沒有權限主權」與誠實階梯（演出未發生的安全狀態、AI 可讓角色偽稱處於它自己都不知道真假的安全態）。這不是風格偏好，也未被任何我能找到的測試或其他機制覆蓋——甚至比 finding 原文描述的還更深一層（Gateway 本身的 Queue policy 也沒有攔阻），沒有找到任何反駁點。

refuted.fix: 在 spriteIntents.ts 的 variant 替換處改成白名單：只有「非安全動畫」可被 variant 指名——排除 SPRITE_INTENT_ANIMATION 中屬於安全 intent 的所有目標（emergency/offline/blocked/unknown/failed/paused/cancelled/ask/waiting/success），而不是只排除 "success"；等價地在 MixerRenderer/machineEventForAnimation 加一道「adapter 送來的名稱不得產生 base 事件或 force clear-transient」的守門。同時補一條回歸測試：AI 來源的每個 variant 都不得讓 machine 進 emergency/offline base、不得產生 force clear-transient。
refuted.regressionTest: Not applicable — finding not confirmed as stated; if the narrower 'paused'/'idle' force-clear timing gap is pursued separately, a regression test would drive a real character_project_plan_blocked push through the runtime, then immediately queue companion.animation.play{animation:"idle"} via the actuator, and assert the machine's blocked transient is NOT cleared before its DURATION.blocked (4500ms) window / before an explicit ack, even though the underlying sprite command's own short animation loop already completed. / 在 Gateway＋SpriteCharacterAdapter＋MixerRenderer 組成的端到端測試中，先建立一則真實 plan.blocked（intent=Blocked, truthState=Blocked）並確認 sprite 進入 blocked transient；接著模擬 AI 呼叫 companion.animation.play{animation:"paused"}（走 policy／character_ai_present 真實路徑），斷言：(a) 產生的 envelope intent 仍非安全但 machine 收到的事件不得是 force:true 的 clear-transient，或 (b) reduce() 對安全 transient 未到期時，即使收到 clear-transient(force:true) 也必須先驗證此 force 事件確實源自 emergency.stop／estop clear-all 這條真實通路（例如加一個不可偽造的來源標記），而非任何可由 variant 字串觸發的路徑；同時斷言 variant="emergency"/"offline"/"blocked"/"unknown" 在 intent 非安全時不得產生與對應安全 intent 完全相同的 machine base／transient kind。

refuted.title: shu 參考 adapter 的 variant 把 Runtime 對 AI 的 wait→think 降級又還原回「等待結果」，AI 也能演出「裝置離線」
refuted.claim: Rust 端刻意把 AI 請求的 wait 降級成 think（wait 的 priority floor 60、isSafetyIntent=true、不在 AI_REQUESTABLE_INTENTS），只把原意圖留成 variant 提示。但 shuExpressionPlan 的 `case "think"` 看到 variant="wait-attention" 就回 plan("waiting")，machineEventForAnimation("waiting") 產生 kind="waiting-for-receipt"（machine PRIORITY 40、DURATION 10 s、裙擺 amber＋dots 浮標＝§4.2 的 waiting 輔助狀態）。降級因此被 adapter 還原，AI 可在 runtime 根本沒有等待任何回執時讓角色演「等待結果」10 秒，並取得比 notice(25)／thinking(30) 更高的舞台優先權。同一條路徑上 NOTICE_VARIANTS["device-offline"]→device-lost（「裝置離線」：耳朵下垂、裙擺 amber 0.4）也可在沒有任何裝置事件時被 AI 點播。
refuted.evidence:
crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:445 `"wait-attention" => (I::Wait.ai_safe_substitute(), Some("wait-attention"))`；crates/interaction-character/src/intent.rs:120-128 `ai_safe_substitute`（Wait→Think）；shuTables.ts:273-274 `case "think": return plan(v === "wait-attention" ? "waiting" : "thinking", "transient")`；shuTables.ts:206 `NOTICE_VARIANTS["device-offline"] = "device-lost"`；shu.ts:330 `shuExpressionPlan(intent, envelope.truthState, envelope.presentationHints?.variant)`。實測：
ai intent=notice variant=wait-attention -> anim=waiting machineEvent={"type":"transient","kind":"waiting-for-receipt"} until=10000 pose={"animation":"waiting"}
ai intent=think  variant=wait-attention -> 同上
ai intent=notice variant=device-offline -> expr=device-lost（expressions.ts:1376 hold skirtGlow 0.4 / skirtTone amber / earR 0）
protocol.ts:267 `wait: 60` 且 AI_REQUESTABLE_INTENTS = rest,notice,think,work,acknowledge（不含 wait）。

verdicts.reasoning:
機制描述本身正確（已逐行核對）：
- crates/interaction-character/src/intent.rs:120-128 `ai_safe_substitute`：Wait→Think。
- crates/interaction-runtime/src/character.rs:445 `"wait-attention" => (I::Wait.ai_safe_substitute(), Some("wait-attention"))`。
- apps/interaction-desktop/src/character/adapters/shuTables.ts:273-274 `case "think": return plan(v === "wait-attention" ? "waiting" : "thinking", "transient")`，206 `NOTICE_VARIANTS["device-offline"]="device-lost"`。
- apps/interaction-desktop/src/companion/machine.ts：`"waiting"→kind "waiting-for-receipt"`，PRIORITY 40、DURATION 10000ms，均高於 notice(→performing,25)／thinking(30)。
- crates/interaction-character/src/intent.rs:494 `from_runtime` 內 `duration_hint: None`，`from_ai_request` 呼叫時同樣未帶 duration，故 AI 這條路確實吃到預設 10s。

但這是**協定明文規定、且被測試整組釘死的設計**，不是外洩／繞過：
1. docs/character-protocol/README.md:336（CPP 1.0 §11 事件投影表，唯一契約文件）逐字寫著
   `companion.state.present（AI behaviorIntent） | …；wait-attention→think（variant wait-attention）…`，
   這正是 finding 指控的那條映射，不是被 adapter 私自「還原」的漏洞，而是 Runtime 自己文件化的降級介面。
2. apps/interaction-desktop/src/test/character-shu-adapter.test.ts:182,185 用整張 20-intent 對照表窮舉斷言
   `["notice","none","device-offline","device-lost"]` 與 `["think","none","wait-attention","waiting"]` 為**預期輸出**，
   代表這組行為是被寫死驗收的既定行為，不是意外通過測試的副作用。
3. 真正的誠實界線——truthState（全程 "none"，never verified/upgrade）、Gateway priority 上限
   (`AI_REQUEST_MAX_PRIORITY=50`，intent.rs:505-527 `from_ai_request` 兩處 `.min(50)`)、
   `interrupt_policy`（非安全 intent 固定 `InterruptPolicy::Queue`，不是 `Preempt`）——全部原封不動，
   adapter 完全沒有偽造這些欄位，符合 CLAUDE.md「truthState／verified 只由 Runtime 決定」的不變量。
4. 「AI 取得比 notice/thinking 更高舞台優先權」不是這條路徑獨有的新能力：AI 用完全合法、無需任何降級把戲的
   `work` intent（`ai_allowed()`＝true，floor 0）就能拿到 machine.ts 的 `"acting"` kind，同樣是 priority 40
   （machine.ts:59 `"waiting-for-receipt": 40` 與 `acting: 40` 同級），可搶占同一段 notice(25)/thinking(30)。
   本地 machine.ts 的 priority 表本來就是「誰的動畫更值得佔舞台」的純呈現層競爭（spec §5.4／behavior.ts 的
   EventClass 分級），不區分事件來源，這是既有、被理解且經過設計的行為，非本 finding 新揭露的漏洞面。
5. `device-lost` 分支落在 `machineEventForAnimation` 的 default（kind="performing"），CompanionApp.tsx:1160
   的 `machineLabel` 對 `"performing"` 回傳 `null`——沒有任何文字向使用者宣稱「裝置離線」，只是外觀（耳朵下垂／
   裙擺 amber）相似，不構成文字層級的誠實違規；且該 pose 名稱本身就是 manifest 宣告的合法 `visual.expression`
   variant（manifest.json:104,299 "device-lost"），不在 `PLAYABLE_DENY_LIST`（presentation.rs:46-58）內，
   本就是設計上允許 AI 直接點播的可玩表情。

結論：finding 對程式碼路徑的每一步描述都準確，但把「Runtime 文件化、TS 測試窮舉釘死的 AI-safe substitute 呈現」
誤判成「被 adapter 私自還原的安全繞過」。truthState／priority 上限／interruptPolicy 這些真正承載安全承諾的欄位
從未被更動或偽造，且相同或更高的舞台優先權本來就能透過完全合法的 `work` intent 取得——不成立。

refuted.fix: variant 只能在「同一語意等級」內換美術：think 的 variant 不得落到 waiting（改成 thinking 的變體，或另建一個非 task-state 的『注意等待』表情）；device-offline 這種宣稱事實的表情應標成 truthState 或只允許 source!=="ai" 的 envelope 點播。與 finding #1 一起，把守門從「來源 intent 是否安全」改成「目的動畫／transient kind 是否安全」。

refuted.title: 活動紀錄收件匣用原始 title，繞過 inboxItemTitle 的人話投影
refuted.claim: `InboxSection` 以 `{String(item.title)}` 直接渲染後端 title，沒有像通知中心（App.tsx:713）與「現在」頁（HomePage.tsx:558）一樣走 `inboxItemTitle(item)`。安全事件的 title 在舊 daemon 就是原始 event_type，而 action-result 的 title 是 runtime 的機器 intent（`emergency-stop`／`presence`／`celebration`），兩者都會以原始字串當一般模式的主標題。
refuted.evidence: ActivityPage.tsx:9 的 import 只有 `agentDisplayLabel, inboxKindLabel, projectInboxStatus`，沒有 `inboxItemTitle`；ActivityPage.tsx:286 `{String(item.title)}`。statusProjection.ts:411-414 的註解明說「安全事件的 `title` 在舊 daemon 是原始 event_type（`emergency.stop`）——一般模式不得把它當標題印出來」。專案自己的測試 fixture 就是這個形狀：src/test/statusProjection.test.tsx:325-333 的項目 `{kind:"safety-event", status:"sensor.started", title:"sensor.started"}` 被餵給 `InboxSection`（該測試只斷言 kind／status 不外洩，沒斷言 title）。action-result 的 title 來源：activity.rs:386 `title: receipt.intent.clone()`，intent 值如 runtime.rs:954 `intent: "emergency-stop"`、orchestrator.rs:305/325 `SemanticIntent::new("celebration")`／`"presence"`。

verdicts.reasoning: 逐項覆核後,finding 的兩個證據支柱都撐不住「ActivityPage 因為沒呼叫 inboxItemTitle 而外洩原始 title」這個因果論述: 1) 行號與程式碼本身無誤: ActivityPage.tsx:286 確實是 `{String(item.title)}`,且該檔案 import 只有 `agentDisplayLabel, inboxKindLabel, projectInboxStatus`,沒有 `inboxItemTitle`(App.tsx:713、HomePage.tsx:558、ConnectPage.tsx:549 都有呼叫)。這部分屬實。 2) 但「安全事件 title 在目前 daemon 是原始 event_type」這個關鍵前提是錯的。我讀了 `crates/interaction-runtime/src/activity.rs:262-284`:目前 runtime 建構 `ActivityInboxItem` 時,title 是**當場**依 `event.event_type` 用 match 產生的中文人話(`"緊急停止已啟動"`、`"緊急停止已解除"`、`感測開始：{sensor}`、`感測停止：{sensor}`、`感測停止結果不確定：{device}`),程式碼自己就寫著註解「標題是人話,不是原始 event_type（原始碼仍在 detail.eventType）」。且輸入事件已被前面的 filter 限制只剩 4 種 EventType,match 每一支都覆蓋到人話,沒有 fallthrough 會漏出原始字串。也就是說,現行 daemon 對 safety-event 這條路徑**从来不会**把原始 event_type 當 title 送到前端 — `statusProjection.ts:411-414` 那段「舊 daemon」註解描述的是版本落差時的防禦性相容殼,不是目前程式碼會走到的路徑。 3) `inboxItemTitle` 本身只在 `item.kind === "safety-event"` 時才轉譯(`statusProjection.ts:422` `if (item.kind !== "safety-event") return title;`),對 `action-result` 一律原樣回傳,不做任何轉換。我用 vitest 實測驗證(把現行 backend 真實會產生的值餵給它): - `inboxItemTitle({kind:"safety-event", title:"緊急停止已啟動", status:"emergency"})` → `"緊急停止已啟動"`(與原始 title 完全相同) - `inboxItemTitle({kind:"action-result", title:"celebration", status:"sent"})` → `"celebration"`(原樣回傳,未翻譯) 兩個案例都證明:在目前程式碼下,ActivityPage 呼不呼叫 `inboxItemTitle` 對渲染結果**完全沒有差異**——不是「少做了投影」,是這個投影對目前這兩種真實輸入本來就是 no-op。 4) finding 引用 action-result title 來源 `activity.rs:386 title: receipt.intent.clone()`,以及 recipe 資產(`crates/interaction-runtime/assets/*.yaml`、`examples/recipes/*.yaml`)裡 `intent: celebration`／`progress`／`warning`／`success` 確認屬實 — 這些機器語意詞確實會被當 title 印出。但這是**所有頁面共通**的缺口(App.tsx/HomePage.tsx 顯示「待決定」的 action-result 項目時也一樣印出原始 intent slug,因為 inboxItemTitle 不處理這個 kind),不是「其他頁面有正確投影、只有 ActivityPage 漏掉」的個別缺陷 — finding 引用 `statusProjection.test.tsx:325-333` 的 fixture `title:"送出桌面通知"`(中文人話)當 action-result 範例,但真實 backend 對 action-result 給的是像 `"celebration"` 這種英文語意詞,不是那個 fixture 假設的中文句子 — 該測試 fixture 本身不代表真實資料形狀,不能拿來佐證「其他頁做對了」。 綜合:finding 描述的「ActivityPage 繞過 inboxItemTitle 因而洩漏原始字串,而通知中心/現在頁沒有這問題」在目前程式碼上不成立 —（a）safety-event 從不洩漏原始 event_type,因為 backend 已在來源端做完人話轉換；（b）action-result 的機器 intent slug 確實會被印出,但這是全頁面共通、且 inboxItemTitle 本來就管不到的缺口,不是 ActivityPage 獨有、也不是「少呼叫一個函式就能解決」的缺陷。呼叫 inboxItemTitle 不會改變任何現行輸出(已用測試驗證)。因此判定 refute。

refuted.fix: 改為 `{inboxItemTitle(item)}`，並讓 action-result 的標題也走 HomePage 的 `receiptIntentLabel`。

refuted.title: 交付報告 §20 引用 acceptance-evidence 明文宣告「不得引用」的量化桶值與 repo 內沒有任何跑法能產生的 8.7 ms
refuted.claim: acceptance-evidence 已明確作廢「9.5 MB → 9.5 MB → 9.5 MB」（Chromium 量化桶值，非量測值，並已在 perf rig 加上偵測到量化值即非零結束的自檢），但 Phase 7 交付報告 §20 仍以「見 §acceptance-evidence 表」為由引用它；同一句引用的「輸入→下一幀 8.3／8.7 ms」裡的 8.7 ms 在 repo 內任何一次 perf 輸出中都不存在（兩份表都是 8.3／8.2），亦即這個數字沒有產生程式，正是規格 §14／§18-20 禁止的無可重現效能宣稱。
refuted.evidence: docs/v05-phase7-final-report.md:184「見 §acceptance-evidence 表：drawRig 0.100 ms、全舞台 0.240 ms、輸入→下一幀 8.3／8.7 ms、heap 9.5 MB 量化、玩具 cap 4、3 天數值穩定」；同檔 :126「`pnpm perf` 的真狀態改變延遲（抓玩具 8.3 ms、看向游標 8.7 ms）」。對照 docs/acceptance-evidence.md:446-447「Phase 7 版本表格引用的「9.5 MB → 9.5 MB → 9.5 MB」是 Chromium 量化桶值（10 000 000 bytes／1 048 576），不是量測值，已由精確位元組取代…數字不得引用」；acceptance-evidence 的兩份 perf 表分別是 :438「看向游標 median 8.3 ms／p95 9.2」與 :576「gaze latency : median 8.300 ms / p95 9.100 ms / max 9.100 ms (n=20)」，均無 8.7。perf-rig.mjs:139-141 亦已加自檢：讀到量化值即 `process.exitCode = 1` 並印「記憶體數字不可引用」。

verdicts.reasoning:
主張的核心事實錯誤：finding 說「8.7 ms 在 repo 內任何一次 perf 輸出中都不存在」，但 `git show 2e02284:docs/acceptance-evidence.md`（Phase 7 交付報告與此表同一個 commit）第 435 行明載「輸入→下一幀：看向游標…median 8.7 ms／p95 9.8（20/20）」，且抓玩具 8.3ms、drawRig 0.100ms、全舞台 0.240ms、heap 9.5MB→9.5MB→9.5MB、cap 4、3 天穩定，全部與 Phase 7 報告 §20（line 184）及 §11（line 126）逐字相符——這是那次 `pnpm perf` 跑出的真實輸出，不是編造數字，確實有「產生程式」（即 perf-rig.mjs 在 Phase 7 session 的實跑），schema 未 quantize 前 gaze latency 本就是 8.7ms。

關於 9.5MB 量化值：acceptance-evidence.md 對它的「已作廢／不得引用」註記是 Phase 8（commit d03e0b9）才加上的，在 Phase 7 report 成文當下（commit 2e02284）尚不存在此警語，acceptance-evidence 當時只誠實標注「量化到 10 MB 級距，只能看數量級」，Phase 7 report 也如實寫「heap 9.5 MB 量化」（自己標明是量化值，並非冒充精確量測）。Phase 8 重新以 --enable-precise-memory-info 跑出精確位元組、gaze latency 也改測出 8.3ms 而非 8.7ms，並更新了 acceptance-evidence.md，但**沒有**回頭修改 docs/v05-phase7-final-report.md——git log 顯示該檔案只在 2e02284 出現過一次提交，d03e0b9（Phase 8）完全沒有碰它。

v05-phase7-final-report.md 是一份標明日期（2026-08-28）的 Phase 7 階段性交付快照文件，不是持續維護的活文件；acceptance-evidence.md 本身的行文慣例也是如此對待舊 Phase 快照（例如同一段文字裡「Phase 6 文件裡的『drawRig 0.452 ms（2.2x）』沒有任何產生程式，已作廢」——只在活文件裡註記舊快照已被取代，不會回頭竄改歷史快照本身）。所以這是「兩份文件因後續重跑而不同步」的文件維護落差，跟 finding 指控的「引用一個從未被任何跑法產生過的、規格禁止的無可重現數字」是完全不同性質、也遠更輕微的問題——finding 的具體證據鏈（「8.7 這數字在 repo 裡任何 perf 輸出都不存在」）被 git 歷史直接證偽，故 refute。

refuted.fix: 把 phase7 報告 §20（:184）與 §12（:126）改成只指向 acceptance-evidence 的現行表格，或就地更正為 8.3 ms 並把 heap 那句換成精確位元組列（2.56→3.60→2.20 MB）＋一句「舊的 9.5 MB 為量化桶值，已作廢」，避免 repo 內同時存在兩個互相矛盾的交付數字。
